calling_features.name: Umbria's Door

calling_features.description: Your Avatar form wears a red-oak mantle and grants the fear aura: an enemy that starts its turn within 10 ft of you makes a Judgment roll or is frightened until the end of its turn. You see invisible and ethereal spirits within 60 ft, and once during the Avatar you can use Turn the Unholy / Bind the Hollow as a bonus action without spending Oath Channel.
calling_features.name: Avatar of Umber

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: each enemy of your choice within 60 ft makes a Confidence roll. Undead and Hollow take 10d10 radiant and are turned for 1 minute on a failure (half, not turned, on a success); other enemies take 5d10 necrotic (half on a success).
calling_features.name: Mythic Requiem

calling_features.description: 10-minute ritual, 1 use per long rest, story-gated: call the willing soul of someone who died within the last 10 days. It appears for 1 hour, can speak and act with its former abilities, and can't be forced to stay. The DM decides which souls can answer.
calling_features.name: Gate of Returning

calling_features.description: Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: outline a creature within 60 ft in starlight for 1 minute. It gains no benefit from invisibility or being hidden against you or your allies, and your attacks on it score a critical hit on 19–20 until you hit it with Divine Smite. Oath spells: Glowmark, Starlance (3rd tier at 9: Noonlight, Spellbreak).
calling_features.name: Star Mark

calling_features.description: Your aura sheds dim starlight. You and allies in it have advantage on saves against illusions and being charmed.
calling_features.name: Aura of Clarity

calling_features.description: Once per turn, the radiant damage of your Divine Smite ignores resistance, and the target makes a Endurance roll or is knocked prone.
calling_features.name: Void-Edged Smite

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: one creature within 60 ft makes a Judgment roll or is incapacitated for 1 minute (save ends).
calling_features.name: Silent Constellation

calling_features.description: Your Avatar form grants a 60 ft fly speed (hover). Your smite damage is split evenly between force and radiant.
calling_features.name: Avatar of Starlight

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: enemies of your choice within 30 ft make a Endurance roll, taking 12d10 radiant and being blinded until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.
calling_features.name: Mythic Nova

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: every enemy in your aura is Star Marked, and you and allies in your aura have truesight to 60 ft.
calling_features.name: Absolute Horizon

calling_features.description: Mounting or dismounting costs 5 ft of movement, and you have advantage on saves to stay in the saddle. While mounted, a lance has 10 ft reach, can be used one-handed, and has no disadvantage against adjacent targets. Reaction: when an attack hits your mount, it hits you instead.
calling_features.name: Born to the Saddle

calling_features.description: Once per turn, if you (or your mount) move at least 20 ft straight toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack, deal +1d8 damage and it makes a Might roll or falls prone. Your mount's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from creatures you hit this turn.
calling_features.name: Wheeling Charge

calling_features.description: When you hit a mounted creature, or a Large or smaller creature with a charge, it makes a Might roll or is dismounted and knocked prone.
calling_features.name: Unseat

calling_features.description: Wheeling Charge damage becomes 2d8. When you take the Attack action while mounted, your mount can make one attack using your Proficiency Bonus in place of its own.
calling_features.name: Ferocious Charger

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest, if you have no living mount: summon a spectral warhorse for 1 hour (AC 13 + Proficiency Bonus, HP 5 × Knight level, speed 60 ft). It acts on your turn and obeys your commands.
calling_features.name: Spirited Mount

calling_features.description: Your mount can move through hostile creatures' spaces. Each creature it passes through makes a Precision roll or takes 2d8 bludgeoning and falls prone.
calling_features.name: Mythic Cavalry

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: allies within 30 ft gain +20 ft speed and their movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Your Wheeling Charge deals maximum damage, and creatures it hits make a Judgment roll or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
calling_features.name: Thunder of Hooves

calling_features.description: Reaction while wielding a shield, when an ally within 5 ft is hit: add 2 + your Proficiency Bonus to its AC against that attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss.
calling_features.name: Interpose

calling_features.description: While you wield a shield, at the start of each of your turns choose one ally within 5 ft; until your next turn it uses your AC if yours is higher.
calling_features.name: Wall of Iron

calling_features.description: Reaction when a creature moves at least 10 ft toward you and ends within your reach: make an opportunity attack with advantage. On a hit, its speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.
calling_features.name: Brace vs Charge

calling_features.description: You and allies adjacent to you have half cover against ranged attacks and advantage on Might rolls.
calling_features.name: Phalanx Tactics

calling_features.description: You can't be moved or knocked prone against your will, and the ground within your reach is difficult terrain for enemies.
calling_features.name: Immovable Object

calling_features.description: Unbreakable Guard works for allies within 15 ft: you move to a space adjacent to them first without provoking. Interpose adds 4 + your Proficiency Bonus instead.
calling_features.name: Mythic Bastion

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 per long rest: allies within 15 ft have three-quarters cover, you gain temp HP equal to your Knight level at the start of each turn, and once per turn you can Interpose without a reaction.
calling_features.name: Living Rampart

calling_features.description: After a short or long rest, designate one willing creature as your VIP. Reaction when a creature attacks your VIP within 10 ft of you: swap places with the VIP and become the attack's target (it uses your AC).
calling_features.name: Bodyguard's Bond

calling_features.description: When a creature attacks your VIP, you can Challenge it with no action and without spending a use.
calling_features.name: Royal Challenge

calling_features.description: Reaction when a creature within your reach attacks your VIP: make one weapon attack against it first. On a hit, deal +1d8 damage and its attack has disadvantage.
calling_features.name: Protector's Strike

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: a creature within 60 ft that understands you makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence or Might modifier) or obeys a one-word command (halt, kneel, drop, flee, approach) on its next turn.
calling_features.name: Courtly Authority

calling_features.description: Unbreakable Guard costs no uses when you protect your VIP, and it works within 30 ft (you move next to the VIP first without provoking).
calling_features.name: Die for the Crown

calling_features.description: You can have two VIPs. While within 30 ft of you, each VIP has +2 AC and resists damage from creatures you've Challenged.
calling_features.name: Mythic Regent Guard

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest, reaction when a VIP within 30 ft takes damage: you take all of it instead. For the next minute you can take one extra reaction each round.
calling_features.name: Sovereign's Shadow

calling_features.description: Choose permanently. Point-Blank: no disadvantage on ranged attacks for being within 5 ft of an enemy. Longshot: your ranged weapons' normal and long ranges increase by half, and you ignore half cover at long range.
calling_features.name: Point-Blank or Longshot

calling_features.description: Bonus action: your next ranged weapon attack this turn has advantage. Proficiency Bonus uses per rest.
calling_features.name: Aimed Shot

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: make one ranged attack against each creature you choose within a 10-ft radius of a point in range (one ammunition each).
calling_features.name: Volley
calling_features.feature_description: Action: make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you choose within range (separate rolls; one attack each). Once per short rest.

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: when you hit with a ranged attack, the shot continues to a second creature in a straight line behind the first; roll a separate attack against it.
calling_features.name: Piercing Round

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 use per rest: make three ranged weapon attacks against marked or favored enemies.
calling_features.name: Rain of Arrows

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: a ranged attack ignores full cover if you know the target's location (the shot curves or punches through).
calling_features.name: Mythic Bowman

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest: a ranged hit against your marked quarry in sight is automatically a critical hit.
calling_features.name: Horizon Kill

calling_features.description: Bond a beast companion (land, air, or water form). Medium, AC 13 + Proficiency Bonus, HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level, speed 40 ft (air: fly 60 ft, HP 4 × Ranger level + 4), your saves. Attack: + Proficiency Bonus + Judgment modifier to hit, 1d8 + Proficiency Bonus damage. It acts on your initiative right after you and Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it (or replace one of your attacks with its attack). If it dies, bond a new one after a long rest.
calling_features.name: Companion

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature, your companion can use its reaction to attack that creature.
calling_features.name: Coordinated Attack

calling_features.description: Your companion gains Evasion. 1 use per rest, it can also halve one attack's damage as a reaction.
calling_features.name: Beast's Defense

calling_features.description: Your companion's hits deal your Mark of the Hunter damage (once per turn) against your marked target.
calling_features.name: Shared Mark

calling_features.description: Your companion resists nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and makes death saves instead of dying at 0 HP.
calling_features.name: Primal Bond

calling_features.description: Choose: a second, lesser companion (half HP, no Shared Mark), or your companion grows Large (HP doubled, damage 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus).
calling_features.name: Mythic Alpha

calling_features.description: Once on each of your turns, your companion makes one attack for free without your command, and you and your companion share Mark of the Hunter concentration (damage to either can't break it).
calling_features.name: Twin Souls

calling_features.description: Two-weapon fighting is built in: you add your ability modifier to off-hand damage, and the off-hand weapon needn't be light if both are finesse. You learn one extra Ranger cantrip and gain expanded spells: choose one illusion or movement Mage spell of a tier you can cast now and at 5, 9, and 13; they count as Ranger spells and are always prepared; your spell DC can use Precision or Judgment.
calling_features.name: Twin Blades and Hexed Steel

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: after you hit with both weapons on your turn, cast a 1st-tier Ranger spell as a bonus action.
calling_features.name: Skirmish Spell

calling_features.description: When both of your weapons hit the same creature in one turn, apply or refresh Mark of the Hunter on it without an action or a free cast.
calling_features.name: Flurry Mark

calling_features.description: After you Disengage or cast a movement spell, your next dual-wield attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.
calling_features.name: Blurred Steps

calling_features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon, spend a slot: +2d8 force for a 1st-tier slot, +1d8 per tier above 1st (max 5d8). Once per turn.
calling_features.name: Spellsteel

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest: concentrate on two Ranger spells at once for 1 minute.
calling_features.name: Mythic Stalker

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: each Attack action is five finesse strikes (canon said four; raised by one because the Ranger now has 4 attacks at 20); you can replace one with a Ranger cantrip.
calling_features.name: Twin Weave Blades

calling_features.description: At the start of your turn, if you're touching natural wood, earth, or stone, you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Judgment modifier.
calling_features.name: Bark Ward

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when a Druid spell hits a creature or it fails a save against one, it also makes a Might roll or is restrained until the end of its next turn. Judgment modifier uses per long rest.
calling_features.name: Land's Grasp

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: using 5 ft of movement, step into a tree and out of another you know within 500 ft.
calling_features.name: Tree Stride

calling_features.description: Once per long rest, commune with an anchor-bound site within 1 mile and ask the DM three questions about it. While touching the ground you have tremorsense to 30 ft.
calling_features.name: Anchor Echo

calling_features.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: a 30-ft-radius grove within 60 ft. Allies starting their turn in it regain Judgment modifier HP; it's difficult terrain for enemies, and an enemy entering it for the first time on a turn makes a Might roll or is restrained (save ends).
calling_features.name: Living Grove

calling_features.description: Bark Ward temporary HP doubles. Living Grove has a 60-ft radius and 2 uses per long rest.
calling_features.name: Mythic Worldtree

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: roots erupt within 60 ft of you. Enemies there make a Might roll, taking 10d8 bludgeoning and being restrained for 1 minute on a failure (save ends), or half damage on a success.
calling_features.name: Root of Ages

calling_features.description: You can Wild Shape as a bonus action, and your CR limit is your Druid level ÷ 3 (minimum 1) if higher than the table. While shaped, bonus action: spend a slot to regain 1d8 HP per slot tier.
calling_features.name: Combat Shape

calling_features.description: Your beast attacks count as magical, and once per turn a beast hit deals +1d8 force.
calling_features.name: Primal Strike

calling_features.description: Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of CR up to your limit + 1.
calling_features.name: Elemental Shape

calling_features.description: Bonus action, no use spent: keep your own body and statistics but gain natural weapons (magical, 1d10 + Judgment modifier, Judgment to hit), +2 AC, and one beast movement mode (climb, swim, or 30 ft fly) for 10 minutes.
calling_features.name: Hybrid Form
calling_features.feature_description: Bonus action: hybrid form 10 minutes — keep hands/speech, natural weapons 1d8, AC 13 + Precision, speed +10. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

calling_features.description: While shaped, your first hit each turn deals +2d8, and you have advantage on attacks against creatures below half HP. When you shift, creatures you choose within 30 ft make a Judgment roll or are frightened of you for 1 minute (save ends). (Circle of Beasts keeps this name; the Berserker's L30 title is Wrathborn.)
calling_features.name: Apex Predator

calling_features.description: When you shift, combine the traits of up to three beasts you've seen: all their movement modes and senses, and one special attack from each.
calling_features.name: Mythic Chimera Shape

calling_features.description: Once per turn, as part of your movement, shift into another form without spending a use. Your form pool becomes 4 × Druid level.
calling_features.name: Thousand Forms

calling_features.description: After each long rest choose a season. Spring: your healing spells restore +Judgment modifier HP. Summer: once per spell, add Judgment modifier to fire or radiant damage. Autumn: a creature that fails your spell's save has -1d4 on its next save. Winter: creatures you deal cold damage to lose 10 ft of speed until your next turn.
calling_features.name: Seasonal Boon

calling_features.description: Action, concentration up to 10 minutes, 1 use per rest: within 60 ft of you call rain (lightly obscured, extinguishes flames), gale (ranged weapon attacks have disadvantage), fog (heavily obscured), or heat (allies resist cold).
calling_features.name: Weather Call

calling_features.description: Action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: flip a 30-ft-radius zone within 60 ft. Spring: allies starting their turn there regain 1d6 HP. Summer: enemies starting there take 2d6 fire. Autumn: enemies there have disadvantage on Judgment rolls. Winter: difficult terrain, and enemies starting there take 2d6 cold.
calling_features.name: Sudden Season

calling_features.description: As a Wild Shape option, become a living storm: fly 60 ft (hover), resist lightning and thunder, and creatures you choose that start their turn within 10 ft make a Precision roll or take 2d8 lightning.
calling_features.name: Storm Shape

calling_features.description: You hold two Seasonal Boons at once, and you can change them on a short rest.
calling_features.name: Year's Cycle

calling_features.description: You hold all four Seasonal Boons. Sudden Season has a 60-ft radius and 2 uses per rest.
calling_features.name: Mythic Equinox

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: a 120-ft radius around you becomes the season of your choice, applying Sudden Season effects with doubled dice.
calling_features.name: Eternal Season

calling_features.description: When you rage, you can choose to frenzy: for that rage you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns. When the rage ends, you gain 1 level of exhaustion.
calling_features.name: Frenzy

calling_features.description: While raging, you're immune to being charmed or frightened; such effects on you end when you enter a rage.
calling_features.name: Mindless Rage

calling_features.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft damages you: make one melee weapon attack against it.
calling_features.name: Retaliation

calling_features.description: Your first frenzy each long rest causes no exhaustion, and a short rest removes one level of exhaustion gained from frenzy.
calling_features.name: Improved Frenzy

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, move up to 10 ft (no opportunity attacks) and make one more melee weapon attack.
calling_features.name: Relentless Assault

calling_features.description: Your frenzy bonus action makes two melee weapon attacks instead of one.
calling_features.name: Mythic Blur of Blades

calling_features.description: Action while raging, 1 use per long rest: move up to your speed without provoking, and make one melee weapon attack against each creature that comes within your reach during the move.
calling_features.name: Storm of Slaughter

calling_features.description: While raging, you gain +1 AC (stacks with Unarmored Defense or armor).
calling_features.name: Thick Skin

calling_features.description: Reaction while raging, when you're hit: reduce the damage by 1d10 + Endurance modifier. Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest.
calling_features.name: Guarded Stance

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest, when you enter a rage: for that rage, allies adjacent to you reduce bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage they take by your Endurance modifier.
calling_features.name: Bastion Rage

calling_features.description: While raging: forced movement against you is reduced by 10 ft, you have advantage on checks to shove or grapple, and a creature that fails to move you takes your Rage damage bonus.
calling_features.name: Bedrock Rage

calling_features.description: While raging, difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you can move through the space of a Large or smaller hostile creature; it makes a Might roll or falls prone.
calling_features.name: Juggernaut

calling_features.description: While raging, critical hits against you become normal hits, and Thick Skin becomes +3 AC.
calling_features.name: Mythic Iron Body

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: reduce all damage you take by your Endurance modifier + Proficiency Bonus, and allies adjacent to you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
calling_features.name: Unbreakable Mountain

calling_features.description: While you're at or below half your HP (bloodied), once per turn your melee hits deal +1d6.
calling_features.name: Blood Fracas

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you score a critical hit or drop a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, regain 1d10 + Endurance modifier HP.
calling_features.name: Crimson Feed

calling_features.description: You know the location of any bloodied creature within 60 ft that isn't behind total cover, and you have advantage on checks to track bloodied creatures.
calling_features.name: Scent of Blood

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit while raging, the target bleeds: it takes 1d6 slashing at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute (Endurance roll at the end of each of its turns ends it; doesn't stack).
calling_features.name: Hemorrhage

calling_features.description: Bonus action while raging, 1 use per rest: enemies within 10 ft make a Endurance roll, taking 4d8 necrotic and starting to bleed (as Hemorrhage) on a failure, or half damage on a success. You regain HP equal to half the total damage dealt.
calling_features.name: Blood Storm

calling_features.description: While raging, Blood Fracas applies even when you aren't bloodied, and its die becomes a d10.
calling_features.name: Mythic Red Tide

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: your melee attacks score a critical hit on 18–20 against bloodied creatures, and Crimson Feed has no once-per-turn limit.
calling_features.name: Carnage Sovereign

calling_features.description: Your speed increases by 10 ft. If you move at least 20 ft on your turn before your first unarmed strike, that strike has advantage.
calling_features.name: Tiger's Rush

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when the Tiger's Rush strike hits, the target makes a Might roll or falls prone.
calling_features.name: Pounce

calling_features.description: Each Flurry strike that hits deals an extra 1d4 slashing damage.
calling_features.name: Raking Flurry

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 Grit: mark a creature for 1 minute. You know where it is within 60 ft, and your first strike against it each turn has advantage.
calling_features.name: Predator's Eye

calling_features.description: When you hit the same creature with three or more strikes in one turn, the last one deals +2d8 and the creature can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
calling_features.name: Hunting Rhythm

calling_features.description: Your speed increases by another 20 ft, Tiger's Rush needs only 10 ft of movement, and you can move after striking without provoking from the creature you struck.
calling_features.name: Mythic Tiger

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: the Tiger's Rush advantage applies to all your strikes, and once per turn a hit on a prone creature deals +2d8.
calling_features.name: Sovereign Cat

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, you can also try to grapple the target (Large or smaller; Might or Precision roll vs your class DC). You can still Flurry while grappling.
calling_features.name: Crushing Grab

calling_features.description: You gain +1 AC, and at the start of each of your turns while you're grappling a creature you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
calling_features.name: Thick Hide

calling_features.description: Your strikes against a creature you're grappling deal +1d8.
calling_features.name: Maul

calling_features.description: A creature you grapple has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you and on checks or saves to escape, and it can't teleport.
calling_features.name: Unbearable Hold

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 use per rest: gain temporary HP equal to twice your Pugilist level and advantage on Endurance rolls for 1 minute.
calling_features.name: Hibernating Guard

calling_features.description: You can grapple two creatures at once and grapple Huge creatures. Maul becomes 2d8.
calling_features.name: Mythic Bear

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: a creature you're grappling makes a Endurance roll, taking 10d10 bludgeoning and being stunned until the end of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.
calling_features.name: Mountain's Hug

calling_features.description: While unarmored, you gain +1 AC.
calling_features.name: Iron Bones

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: when you hit, the target's AC drops by 2 until the end of your next turn.
calling_features.name: Break Guard

calling_features.description: When you hit, spend 1 Grit: the target makes a Might roll or is pushed 15 ft and knocked prone.
calling_features.name: Shockwave Palm

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: when you hit, the target's armor stops counting until the end of your next turn (its AC becomes 10 + Precision modifier + shield or natural bonus).
calling_features.name: Shatterplate

calling_features.description: Your strikes deal double damage to objects and structures and +1d8 to constructs.
calling_features.name: Siege Fists

calling_features.description: Iron Bones becomes +3 AC. Break Guard can be used once per turn by spending 1 Grit.
calling_features.name: Mythic Iron

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you can't be moved or knocked prone, and each of your hits lowers the target's AC by 1 (max -5) until the effect ends.
calling_features.name: Living Anvil

calling_features.description: While an ally within 5 ft of you wields a polearm or reach weapon, you and that ally gain +1 AC.
calling_features.name: Lockstep

calling_features.description: Allies within 5 ft of you have half cover against attacks from creatures that are closer to you than to them.
calling_features.name: Wall of Points

calling_features.description: You and allies within 10 ft of you have advantage on saves and checks against being shoved, pushed, or knocked prone.
calling_features.name: Hold Fast

calling_features.description: When you use Brace / Skewer, one ally within 10 ft wielding a melee weapon can use its reaction to attack the same creature.
calling_features.name: Combined Brace

calling_features.description: Allies within 10 ft of you who wield polearms gain your Reach Tactics benefit.
calling_features.name: Fortress Line

calling_features.description: Lockstep becomes +2 AC, and Wall of Points grants three-quarters cover.
calling_features.name: Mythic Phalanx

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you and allies within 15 ft can't be moved or knocked prone, and each of them can make one opportunity attack per round without spending a reaction.
calling_features.name: Unbroken Spearwall

calling_features.description: Your standing jumps cover the distance of running jumps. Once per turn, if you jump at least 10 ft right before a melee attack, it deals +1d8.
calling_features.name: Vault Strike

calling_features.description: Your jump distance doubles, and your jumps don't provoke opportunity attacks.
calling_features.name: Leaping Charge

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: after you jump or while you're above your target, you have advantage on all your attacks this turn.
calling_features.name: Aerial Threat

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: leap up to 60 ft and land in a space you can see, taking no falling damage. Creatures within 5 ft of where you land make a Precision roll, taking 4d10 piercing and falling prone on a failure, or half damage on a success.
calling_features.name: Dragoon Descent

calling_features.description: Bonus action: hook a surface or creature within your reach + 10 ft and pull yourself next to it. When you hit a flying creature, it makes a Might roll or is dragged down to the ground within your reach and knocked prone.
calling_features.name: Skyhook

calling_features.description: On your turn you have a 30 ft fly speed as long as you end your move on a surface. Dragoon Descent has 2 uses per rest.
calling_features.name: Mythic Vault

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest, replacing a Dragoon Descent: leap up to 120 ft; creatures within 20 ft of where you land make a Precision roll, taking 10d10 force and falling prone on a failure, or half on a success. Then make one polearm attack against each creature within your reach.
calling_features.name: Starfall Lance

calling_features.description: While wielding a spear in each hand you gain the Two-Weapon (dual spears) style benefits (if you already have it, swap it for another Lancer style). Once per turn, when both spears hit the same creature on your turn, Measured Thrust slows it by 20 ft instead of 10.
calling_features.name: Twin Fangs

calling_features.description: While wielding a spear in each hand you gain +1 AC. From level 7, your Haft Parry bonus also applies to every other attack the same creature makes against you that turn.
calling_features.name: Crossed Guard

calling_features.description: While dual-wielding, Brace / Skewer attacks with both spears (two rolls). The +1d8 applies to one hit of your choice; the stop applies if either hits.
calling_features.name: Double Brace

calling_features.description: Your off-hand bonus action makes two attacks with the off-hand spear instead of one.
calling_features.name: Flurry of Points

calling_features.description: Once per round, when you make an opportunity attack while dual-wielding, attack with each spear as part of the same reaction.
calling_features.name: Paired Sentinel

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with one spear after hitting it with the other earlier that turn, the second hit is a critical hit.
calling_features.name: Mythic Twinstrike

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: move up to your speed without provoking. Make one attack with each spear against each creature that comes within your reach during the move (max one per spear per creature); Measured Thrust can apply to each creature hit.
calling_features.name: Two Spear Tempest

calling_features.description: You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet this combat, and any hit you score against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
calling_features.name: Assassinate

calling_features.description: Bonus action while in dim light or darkness: teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness you can see. Your next melee attack this turn has advantage.
calling_features.name: Shadow Step

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you deal Sneak Attack damage on your turn, you can make one more weapon attack as a bonus action (it can't deal Sneak Attack).
calling_features.name: Stalker's Flurry

calling_features.description: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Endurance roll against your class DC; on a failure, the attack's damage is doubled.
calling_features.name: Death Strike

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per rest: a shadow clone appears within 30 ft (your AC, 1 HP). It counts as an ally for Sneak Attack, moves 30 ft when you use a bonus action to command it, and you can Shadow Step into its space.
calling_features.name: Living Shadow

calling_features.description: Living Shadow has HP equal to your Assassin level and 2 uses per rest; when you take the Attack action, the clone can make one weapon attack using your bonus (no Sneak Attack).
calling_features.name: Mythic Umbral Twin

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: darkness you can see through fills 15 ft around you, you're invisible while in dim light or darkness, and your Sneak Attack dice become d8s.
calling_features.name: Eclipse Blade

calling_features.uses: Proficiency Bonus doses per long rest
calling_features.description: After each long rest you have basic doses equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Bonus action: coat a weapon for 1 minute or until it hits. On the hit, the target takes +2d6 poison and makes a Endurance roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Precision modifier) or is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
calling_features.name: Poisoner

calling_features.description: When a creature fails the save against your dose, also choose one: speed halved, no reactions, or disadvantage on its next attack roll (until the end of its next turn).
calling_features.name: Debilitating Mix

calling_features.description: You resist poison damage. When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes poison damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
calling_features.name: Toxic Blood

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: one dose ignores poison resistance and immunity to the poisoned condition.
calling_features.name: Master Toxin

calling_features.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per long rest (or spend 2 doses): a 20-ft-radius toxic cloud within 60 ft, heavily obscured. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a Endurance roll, taking 6d8 poison on a failure or half on a success.
calling_features.name: Cloudkill Kiss

calling_features.description: You're immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. You have 2 × Proficiency Bonus doses, and dose damage becomes 4d6.
calling_features.name: Mythic Venom Lord

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest, on a coated hit: the target makes a Endurance roll. On a failure it drops to 0 HP; on a success it takes 10d10 poison. Story-gated legends instead take 10d10 poison and are poisoned for 1 minute.
calling_features.name: Perfect Toxin

calling_features.description: During a short rest, craft a disguise; you have advantage on checks to pass as someone else while wearing it. You can mimic any voice you've heard for at least 1 minute.
calling_features.name: False Face

calling_features.description: You leave no tracks or scent and can't be tracked by nonmagical means. You don't take a Stealth penalty for moving at a normal pace.
calling_features.name: Without a Trace

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per rest: after studying a creature for 1 minute, take its exact appearance and voice for 1 hour. Only truesight sees through it.
calling_features.name: Identity Thief

calling_features.description: 1 per rest: when you Hide in dim light or darkness, you are invisible until the end of your next turn.
calling_features.name: Fade to Nothing

calling_features.description: 1 use per rest: as part of your movement, pass through one wall, door, or barrier up to 10 ft thick.
calling_features.name: Ghost Walk

calling_features.description: You can't be targeted by divination or perceived through scrying. Creatures that aren't hostile don't notice you unless you interact with them.
calling_features.name: Mythic Nonperson

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: each non-legend creature of your choice within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll or forgets everything you did in the last hour; hostile ones lose track of you.
calling_features.name: Forgotten by the World

calling_features.description: Bonus action: mark one creature you can see within 30 ft (lasts 1 minute or until you mark another). It takes +1d6 radiant from your hits (once per turn) and has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.
calling_features.name: Bound Archon

calling_features.description: When your marked target escapes your restraint or moves out of your reach, make one weapon attack against it as a reaction; if it hits, Sigil Strike costs 0.
calling_features.name: Verdict of Chains

calling_features.description: Action, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: 20-ft aura on you for 1 minute (no concentration); enemies' speed is halved in it.
calling_features.name: Iron Edict

calling_features.description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage while at 3+ Cracks.
calling_features.name: Unyielding Law

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: a marked creature within your reach with 50 HP or fewer (100 from 28) makes a Endurance roll (class DC). Fail: it drops to 0 HP. Success: it takes 6d8 radiant. The use is spent either way; legendary-resistance-style features work as normal.
calling_features.name: Sentence Passed

calling_features.description: You can have up to 3 marks at once.
calling_features.name: Mythic Tribunal

calling_features.description: On a failed Breach save, every marked target is stunned until the end of its next turn instead of you (no Archon Breach effect). Sentence Passed works on targets with 100 HP or fewer.
calling_features.name: Archon Unchained

calling_features.description: As an attack, make a 60-ft ranged radiant bolt: 1d8 + Intellect radiant. It counts as a sigil weapon hit for Sigil Strike and Crack damage.
calling_features.name: Bound Seraph

calling_features.description: Wrested Wings gives no Crack, and you can hover. Before you gain Wrested Wings at level 9: when you fall, you descend no faster than 60 ft per round, take no falling damage, and move 2 ft horizontally for every 1 ft you fall.
calling_features.name: Six Wings

calling_features.description: Action, 2 embers, gain 1 Crack: 15-ft burst on you; Endurance roll (class DC): 4d8 radiant and blinded until the end of your next turn; half and not blinded on a success.
calling_features.name: Burning Choir

calling_features.description: Enemies that start their turn within 10 ft of you take radiant damage equal to your Cracks.
calling_features.name: Ember Halo

calling_features.description: If you fly 30+ ft in a straight line toward a target and hit it with a melee attack that turn, double the Sigil Strike dice (once per turn).
calling_features.name: Seraph's Descent

calling_features.description: Radiant Lash can be a 60-ft cone instead of a line.
calling_features.name: Mythic Sixfold Flame

calling_features.description: While at 5 Cracks, at the start of each of your turns roll a d6; on 5-6, your next Radiant Lash this turn costs no embers.
calling_features.name: Seraph Unchained

calling_features.description: Heavy armor proficiency. When Soul Strike hits, you can push the target 5 ft.
calling_features.name: Legion Oath

calling_features.description: While your devil has crossed over, allies adjacent to it gain +2 AC.
calling_features.name: Shield-Brother

calling_features.description: Bonus action, once per turn, gain 1 Strain: allies within 15 ft can each use their reaction to make one weapon attack.
calling_features.name: Drilled Ranks (Strain)

calling_features.description: At 3+ Strain, you can't be pushed or knocked prone.
calling_features.name: March of Iron

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 per long rest, 1 minute: an enemy must succeed on a Might roll (class DC) to move away from you.
calling_features.name: Ranks Unbroken

calling_features.description: 30-ft aura: allies add 1d4 to attack rolls.
calling_features.name: Mythic Standard

calling_features.description: Crossing effect: on a failed control save, the devil guards you and attacks your enemies instead of acting freely.
calling_features.name: Legion Unbound

calling_features.description: Gain medium armor and proficiency with the Broad One-Handed, Versatile and Ranged Two-Handed weapon categories. A creature holding your Inspiration die can add it to one weapon damage roll, or to its AC against one attack (reaction).
calling_features.name: Battle Chorus

calling_features.description: Starting Countercharm ends frightened on allies within 30 ft, and each ally it frees gains temp HP equal to your Confidence modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
calling_features.name: Rallying Refrain

calling_features.description: You make 2 attacks when you take the Attack action, and you can replace one of them with a Songsmith cantrip.
calling_features.name: War Cadence

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon or a cantrip, deal +2d6 thunder; the target makes a Might roll or is pushed 10 ft.
calling_features.name: Thunder Refrain

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 use per rest: allies within 30 ft can each use a reaction to move up to half their speed without provoking, and their next attack before the end of their next turn has advantage.
calling_features.name: March of Conquest

calling_features.description: Combat Anthem gives +2 to attack rolls and reaches 30 ft.
calling_features.name: Mythic War Anthem

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: allies within 30 ft are immune to being frightened or charmed and gain temporary HP equal to your Songsmith level at the start of each of their turns.
calling_features.name: Unbroken Legion

calling_features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 ft that you can see makes an attack roll, check, or damage roll: spend an Inspiration use and subtract the die from the roll. You also gain proficiency in 3 skills of your choice.
calling_features.name: Cutting Words

calling_features.description: You understand every spoken language, and any creature that knows a language understands what you say.
calling_features.name: Universal Tongue

calling_features.description: When you make an ability check, you can spend an Inspiration use to add the die (after seeing the roll).
calling_features.name: Peerless Skill

calling_features.description: Learn two more Magical Secrets-lite spells; after each long rest you can swap one of your Secrets for another.
calling_features.name: Stolen Lore

calling_features.description: 1 use per long rest: cast any spell of 5th tier or lower that you've seen cast, using one of your slots; it counts as a Songsmith spell.
calling_features.name: Living Library

calling_features.description: Once per round, Cutting Words doesn't spend a use.
calling_features.name: Mythic Chronicle

calling_features.description: Action, 1 use per long rest: each creature of your choice within 60 ft makes a Judgment roll or is enthralled for 1 minute: incapacitated and speed 0, ending if it takes damage (legends can spend a legendary resistance).
calling_features.name: Write the Room

calling_features.description: During a short rest, bond with up to 2 weapons you're proficient with. You can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon while conscious, and as a bonus action you can call one to your hand from within 60 ft.
calling_features.name: Weapon Bond

calling_features.description: You gain 4 maneuver dice (d8; d10 at 14, d12 at 24), regained on a short or long rest. Learn 3 maneuvers (one more at 10, 14, and 18): Trip (target makes a Might roll vs your class DC or falls prone), Disarm (Might roll or drops an item), Riposte (reaction attack when a creature misses you in melee), Precision (add the die to an attack roll after seeing it), Push (Might roll or pushed 15 ft), Rally (an ally gains temp HP equal to the die + Might modifier). Add the die to the attack's damage when the maneuver hits.
calling_features.name: Maneuver Dice

calling_features.description: Once per turn, when you hit with a bonded weapon, add one maneuver die to the damage without spending it (roll it; no maneuver effect).
calling_features.name: Master Strike

calling_features.description: At the start of each of your turns choose a form until your next turn: Offense (+2 damage on weapon hits), Guard (+1 AC), or Flow (+10 ft speed and your movement doesn't provoke). Maneuver dice become d10.
calling_features.name: Adaptive Form

calling_features.description: Gain a 5th maneuver die. Once per turn when you score a critical hit or drop a creature to 0 HP, regain 1 maneuver die.
calling_features.name: Endless Arsenal

calling_features.description: Maneuver dice become d12. Once per turn you can apply two different maneuvers to the same hit, spending a die for each.
calling_features.name: Legendary Technique

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: maneuvers don't spend dice (you still roll them), and attacks with bonded weapons score a critical hit on 18–20.
calling_features.name: Living Weapon

calling_features.description: Bonus action, Proficiency Bonus uses per long rest: you become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, and your next attack roll before then has advantage. Oath spells: False Face, Mark of the Hunter (3rd tier at 9: Terror Wave, Scryshroud).
calling_features.name: Veil Step

calling_features.description: When you hit a creature, it's marked until the end of your next turn. While a marked enemy is in your aura, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you.
calling_features.name: Aura of Dread

calling_features.description: Your Divine Smite deals +2d8 psychic when the target can't see you or you're hidden or invisible.
calling_features.name: Ambush Smite

calling_features.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute, 1 use per rest: magical darkness fills a 30-ft radius around you and moves with you. You and allies in your aura can see through it.
calling_features.name: Night Judgment

calling_features.description: Your Avatar form grants a fear gaze: as a bonus action each turn, one creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll or is frightened of you until the end of its next turn. Your smites deal psychic or necrotic (your choice) and add +1d8.
calling_features.name: Avatar of Shadows

calling_features.description: In dim light or darkness, Veil Step costs no uses and doesn't end when you attack.
calling_features.name: Mythic Umbra

calling_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: choose a creature you can see. You always know where it is, it can't teleport or turn invisible to you, your attacks against it have advantage, and once per turn a smite against it uses maximum dice.
calling_features.name: Eclipse Hunt

class_feature_options.name: Mirror Mark
class_feature_options.description: reaction when a Hexed creature hits an ally; the attacker takes the same damage, up to 2d8.

class_feature_options.name: Purging Strike

class_feature_options.name: Steady Hands
class_feature_options.description: Lay on Hands pool +5 × Proficiency Bonus.

class_feature_options.name: Garrote

class_feature_options.name: Smoke Pellet
class_feature_options.description: create a 10 ft cloud of heavy obscurement for 1 round.

class_feature_options.name: Poison Craft

class_feature_options.name: Wall Crawl
class_feature_options.description: climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

class_feature_options.name: Exit Wound

class_feature_options.name: Echo Step
class_feature_options.description: your footsteps make no sound and you leave no tracks.

class_feature_options.name: Banner Oath
class_feature_options.description: bonus action, 1 minute, allies within 10 ft have +1 on saves.

class_feature_options.name: Gauntlet Toss
class_feature_options.description: a Challenged creature that attacks someone else takes 1d8 psychic.

class_feature_options.name: Herald's Voice
class_feature_options.description: advantage on Dominance and Diplomacy with soldiers and nobles.

class_feature_options.name: Saddle-Born
class_feature_options.description: you can't be dismounted against your will, and your mount uses your AC if it's higher.

class_feature_options.name: Shield Wall
class_feature_options.description: an adjacent ally with a shield gives you +1 AC, and you give them +1.

class_feature_options.name: Rescue Charge

class_feature_options.name: Plate-Sworn

class_feature_options.name: Unbowed
class_feature_options.description: when you're knocked prone, stand up at once without spending movement.

class_feature_options.name: Snare Craft
class_feature_options.description: set a trap in 1 minute; the first creature to enter makes a Precision roll or is restrained.

class_feature_options.name: Bird Speech
class_feature_options.description: speak with beasts for 10 minutes.

class_feature_options.name: Forager
class_feature_options.description: on a rest, find food for 6 people and 1 herb that heals 1d8.

class_feature_options.name: Riverborn
class_feature_options.description: swimming speed equal to your walking speed; currents and waves can't knock you prone or move you.

class_feature_options.name: Marksman's Patience
class_feature_options.description: if you don't move this turn, your first ranged hit adds 1d6.

class_feature_options.name: Trail Reader

class_feature_options.name: Studied Prey

class_feature_options.name: Flushing Shot
class_feature_options.description: your first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target strips its half and three-quarters cover against your allies until your next turn.

class_feature_options.name: Barkskin Bond

class_feature_options.name: Seed Bomb
class_feature_options.description: throw a seed (60 ft) that makes a 10 ft area difficult terrain for 1 minute.

class_feature_options.name: Beast Tongue Shift

class_feature_options.name: Rootdrink

class_feature_options.description: resist lightning and thunder while shaped.

class_feature_options.name: Wild Shape (3) and Deep Lungs

class_feature_options.name: Bloodlust Howl

class_feature_options.name: Low Sweep

class_feature_options.name: Counter Jab

class_feature_options.name: Iron Palm
class_feature_options.description: your unarmed strikes count as magical and deal +1 damage to constructs and objects.

class_feature_options.name: Settled Breath
class_feature_options.description: when you roll initiative, gain temp HP equal to your Grit maximum.

class_feature_options.name: Ricochet Step
class_feature_options.description: once per turn, kick off a wall or creature to gain 10 ft movement and +1 AC until your next turn.

class_feature_options.name: Cracking Elbow

class_feature_options.description: a cantrip that deals radiant also gives +1 AC to one ally within 10 ft.

class_feature_options.name: Litany of Vigil
class_feature_options.description: you need only 4 hours of rest, during which you stay alert.

class_feature_options.name: Litany of Sanctuary
class_feature_options.description: bonus action, 1 minute: creatures must make a Judgment roll to target one ally.

class_feature_options.name: Litany of Warding Salt
class_feature_options.description: draw a 10 ft circle undead and Hollow can't enter (Confidence roll).

class_feature_options.name: Litany of Truth
class_feature_options.description: 10 ft zone for 1 minute; creatures in it can't speak a deliberate lie (Confidence roll).

class_feature_options.name: Sacred Reserve
class_feature_options.description: when you heal with a slot, each target regains extra HP equal to your Judgment modifier.

class_feature_options.name: Hallowed Ground
class_feature_options.description: when you finish a short rest, allies gain temp HP equal to your Judgment + level ÷ 2.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Haste
class_feature_options.description: summons gain +10 ft speed.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Iron
class_feature_options.description: summons gain temp HP equal to your Summoner level when they appear.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Sight
class_feature_options.description: see through a summon's senses as a bonus action.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Shelter
class_feature_options.description: a summon within 30 ft of you can take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Return
class_feature_options.description: when a summon drops to 0 HP, it reforms with half HP at your next short rest instead of a long rest.

class_feature_options.name: Seal of Voice
class_feature_options.description: summons can speak and relay your words up to 1 mile away.

class_feature_options.name: Mirror Bond
class_feature_options.description: reaction, swap places with a summon within 60 ft.

class_feature_options.name: Feeding Bond
class_feature_options.description: when a summon kills a creature, you regain 1d8 HP.

class_feature_options.name: Mocking Verse
class_feature_options.description: bonus action, a creature within 60 ft has disadvantage on its next save against you.

class_feature_options.name: Marching Cadence
class_feature_options.description: allies who travel with you ignore forced-march exhaustion and gain +5 ft speed.

class_feature_options.name: Lullaby
class_feature_options.description: a creature at 30 HP or below falls asleep (Judgment roll).

class_feature_options.name: Echo Chord
class_feature_options.description: a Song of Inspiration die that isn't used returns to you.

class_feature_options.name: Sharp Note
class_feature_options.description: when an ally uses your die on an attack, add 1d4 thunder.

class_feature_options.name: Stage Presence
class_feature_options.description: advantage on Showmanship, and creatures watching have disadvantage on Awareness against your allies.

class_feature_options.name: Dancer's Step
class_feature_options.description: after you cast a spell, move 10 ft without provoking.

class_feature_options.name: Battle Hymn
class_feature_options.description: when you spend an inspiration die, you also gain temp HP equal to the roll.

class_feature_options.name: Chain Snap
class_feature_options.description: when a Shackle ends, the creature takes 1d8 radiant.

class_feature_options.name: Halo Glint
class_feature_options.description: Halo Ward also sheds bright light 10 ft; enemies in it can't hide.

class_feature_options.name: Sealed Step
class_feature_options.description: Reseal also lets you move 10 ft without provoking.

class_feature_options.name: Radiant Scar
class_feature_options.description: the first creature you hit each combat loses radiant resistance for 1 minute.

class_feature_options.name: Brand Echo
class_feature_options.description: Call the Brand also reveals the branded creature's location for 1 hour.

class_feature_options.name: Ember Hide
class_feature_options.description: Tempered Hide adds fire resistance.

class_feature_options.name: Quench Vapor
class_feature_options.description: when you Quench, adjacent enemies make a Endurance roll or are blinded until your next turn.

class_feature_options.name: Anvil Ring
class_feature_options.description: on a Soul Strike hit, one other enemy within 10 ft takes 1d4 thunder.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

features.name: Poison Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

features.name: Fire Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

features.name: Cold Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from cold damage.

features.name: Necrotic Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

features.name: Radiant Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

features.name: Lightning Resistance
features.description: You take half damage from lightning damage.

features.name: Greater Curse (4) and Soul Tithe healing
Spell Tier Up and Forms Improve
Death's Cadence
features.description: On a critical hit with a weapon, regain one spent Draw Breath use, or gain temporary hit points equal to Warrior level if none are spent.

features.name: Bloodied Fury
features.description: While you are below half HP, +2 to melee damage and advantage on Might rolls.

features.name: Blood Debt
features.description: While Grudge is active, the first time each turn the marked creature damages you, it takes necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Bloodletting
features.description: When casting a Witch spell of 1st rank+, lose HP equal to slot rank to add 1d8 necrotic to one target (or restore 1d8 for healing spells).

features.name: Blood Bolt
features.description: Action: spend up to proficiency bonus hit dice; each die deals 1d6 necrotic to a creature within 60 feet (Judgment roll vs Confidence DC halves).

features.name: Crimson Bind
features.description: Action: creature within 30 feet makes Endurance roll vs Confidence DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats roll each turn). You lose 1d6 HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Coven Rites
features.description: Learn two Rites. Action: expend a spell slot to enact a known Rite (effects scale with slot rank).

features.name: Cantrips
features.description: You know 2 cantrips from your role's lists. Cantrip damage follows Cantrip scaling rules.

features.name: Angelic Decree
features.description: Action: each enemy of your choice within 30 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Judgment DC or is frightened until the end of your next turn. Once per short rest.

data.duration: until end of your next turn

features.name: Cleansing Grace
features.description: When you use Grace, you may also end one poison, disease, or mild curse on the target.

features.name: Boil Blood
features.description: Action: a hexed or Crimson-Bound creature within 60 feet takes 4d8 necrotic (Endurance vs Confidence DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Blood Pact
features.description: Reaction: ally within 30 feet is hit; you take the damage instead with resistance to it. Once per short rest.

features.name: Death Knell
features.description: When you drop a creature to 0 with necrotic damage, gain temporary HP equal to Witch level + Confidence.

features.name: Decay Field
features.description: Action: 15-ft-radius field within 60 feet for 1 minute; enemies starting turn there take 2d6 necrotic. Once per short rest.

features.name: Ancient Willow
features.description: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to your Templar level + Judgment.

features.name: Borrowed Time
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a death roll, treat it as a success. Once per short rest.

features.name: Dawn's Promise
features.description: When you restore HP to a creature at 0 HP, it may stand (costs no movement) and make one weapon attack as a reaction.

features.name: Death's Embrace
features.description: Heavenly Strike may deal necrotic instead of radiant. Against undead, add +1d8.

features.name: Avenger
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you know the direction to your mark regardless of distance on the same plane, your speed increases by 20 feet toward it, and critical hits against it deal +4d8 necrotic.

features.name: Archmage
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a Mage spell of 1st rank+, treat it as if cast using a slot one rank higher (max 9th). You also regain one expended 1st- or 2nd-rank slot at the start of each of your turns in combat while you have none of those ranks left (once per turn).

features.name: Avatar of the Element
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute you gain immunity to your attuned element, your cantrips of that type deal +2d8, and enemies that hit you in melee take 2d8 of that type.

features.name: Conjure Tool
features.description: Bonus action: create a simple nonmagical object (up to 5 lb) for 1 hour or until dismissed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Bound Ally
features.description: When you summon a creature with a Mage spell, add your proficiency bonus to its AC and attack rolls for the duration.

features.name: Battle Scribe
features.description: Bonus action: activate a prepared combat glyph (blast 2d6 in 10 ft, or shield +2 AC until start of next turn). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Allegiance
features.description: Action: one creature within 60 feet makes a Judgment roll vs your Intellect DC. On a failure it is controlled by you (ally to you) for 1 minute. It repeats the Judgment roll at the end of each of its turns; on a success the effect ends. Once per long rest. Does not work on creatures with legendary resistance-style daily auto-successes unless the Guide allows. Allegiance targets are not summons: they cannot receive Forced Command, do not count against your Legion cap, and only follow simple commands (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or drop an item).

features.name: Bone Armor
features.description: Bonus action: sacrifice an undead summon within 30 feet; you gain temporary HP equal to twice its remaining HP (max 40). Once per short rest.

features.name: Bound Soul
features.description: One undead summon can remain active for 24 hours without counting against your Legion cap overnight (still counts in combat encounters). Refresh on long rest.

features.name: Death's Toll
features.description: When an undead summon drops to 0, enemies within 10 feet of it take 2d8 necrotic (Judgment vs Intellect DC halves).

features.name: Call the Hollow
features.description: Legion can call Hollow spirits (insubstantial; resistance to nonmagical weapons; vulnerable to radiant). Hollows ignore difficult terrain.

features.name: Direct the Horde
features.description: Forced Command can target two Hollows at once (one use).

features.name: Assemble Construct
features.description: Legion can call constructs (armor +1 AC, immunity to poison and psychic). Constructs can be repaired with Scrap Field Repair.

features.name: Death Sentence
features.description: Once per long rest when you hit a Mark for Death target with Hidden Blade, the attack is a critical hit and the mark's bonus becomes +4d6.

features.name: Deathbloom
features.description: Once per long rest, a toxin hit deals 6d6 poison (Endurance halves) and on a failure the target is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Borrowed Face
features.description: Action: alter your appearance (clothing, face, height within 1 foot) for 1 hour. Inspection contests Judgment vs your Confidence. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Ambush
features.description: When you cast an Assassin spell of 1st rank+ while hidden, the target has disadvantage on rolls against its DC, or you have advantage on the spell attack.

features.name: Aegis
features.description: Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet gains +2 AC for 1 minute. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Binding Sigil
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has disadvantage on the first attack each turn against creatures other than you.

features.name: Chains of Faith
features.description: Action: target within 30 feet makes a Might roll vs Judgment DC or is restrained 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per short rest.

features.name: Bloodlust
features.description: While furious, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you may move up to half speed and make one melee attack (once per turn).

features.name: Bleeding Edge
features.description: Bleed dice become 1d6. Critical hits apply bleed automatically without using the once-per-turn limit.

features.name: Barbed Hide
features.description: While furious, creatures that hit you with melee take 1d6 piercing. Scales Ongoing d6 every 5 from 13.

features.name: Blood Feast
features.description: Bonus action while furious: end all bleeds you applied within 60 feet; deal remaining bleed dice as necrotic and regain that much HP. Once per short rest.

features.name: Bone Grip
features.description: While furious, you may dual-wield two-handed melee weapons. When you take the Attack action with one of them, you may make one attack with the other as a bonus action (same dual-wield rhythm as the Assassin: one off-hand attack on the bonus action). The off-hand attack uses the weapon's normal damage die and your Might modifier.

features.name: Crushing Blow
features.description: Once per turn while furious and grown or dual-wielding great weapons, a melee hit deals +1d8 and the target makes a Might roll vs your Might DC or is knocked prone.

features.name: Bone Plating
features.description: While furious, gain temporary HP equal to your Berserker level when you enter Fury, and +1 AC.

features.name: Colossus
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute grow two sizes (Huge if you started Medium), keep Bone Grip dual-wield (one off-hand great-weapon attack as a bonus action), and Crushing Blow becomes +2d8.

features.name: Animal Ally
features.description: You gain a beast companion (CR 1/4 or lower). It acts on your turn; you command it as a bonus action. If it dies, ritual 8 hours to bond another.

features.name: Beast Sight
features.description: Share senses with your companion or a beast within 100 feet for 10 minutes as an action. Once per short rest free; or expend a spell slot of 1st+.

features.name: Celestial Seer
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute gain all three moon phases at once and Starfall recharges on each of your turns (still an action).

features.name: Beast Shape
features.description: Action: assume a beast form (CR 1 or lower) for 1 hour. Retain Judgment and HP; use beast stats otherwise. Uses = 2 per short rest.

features.name: Alpha
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute hybrid form has Extra Attack (two natural attacks), Primal Strikes +2d6, and Pack Leader aura 30 feet.

features.name: Counterpunch
features.description: Reaction: when missed by a melee attack within reach, make one unarmed strike against the attacker. Uses = Speed modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Combo Chain
features.description: When you hit the same creature with three unarmed strikes in one turn, it makes an Endurance roll vs Precision DC or is stunned until the end of your next turn. Once per turn.

features.name: Armor Crack
features.description: When you hit the same creature twice in a turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn (stacks to -3).

features.name: Breaking Point
features.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Weak Point is permanent on one target, Armor Crack stacks to -5, and Precise Blow applies to every hit against it.

features.name: Current Step
features.description: When you Flurry, you may move 10 feet before or between strikes without provoking.

features.name: Bounty
features.description: Bonus action: designate a creature within 60 feet as your Bounty for 1 hour (or until it drops to 0). Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One bounty. Bounty(2) improves.

scaling.change: Bounty(2): +proficiency to track; damage +1d6 more at 8 from scaling

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: Once per turn, treat a ranged weapon attack roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Against your Bounty, critical hits on 19-20.

features.name: Cutpurse's Bane
features.description: Against humanoids marked as Bounty, weapon attacks deal +1d6 and you have advantage on rolls to detect illusions and disguises.

features.name: Bane Strike
features.description: Once per turn against a studied monster type, +2d6 damage and it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Beast Companion
features.description: Beast companion CR 1/4+. Commands as bonus action; shares your initiative. Bond ritual 8 hours if slain.

features.name: Dark Strike
features.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon, deal +1d6 necrotic. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

features.name: Between Worlds
features.description: You can see into the ethereal within 30 feet. Attacks against ethereal creatures within reach have no disadvantage from that state.

features.name: Crossroads Gate
features.description: Action: create a linked pair of gates within 60 feet for 1 minute; any creature entering one exits the other. Once per short rest.

features.name: Augment
features.description: Spend 1 Soul as a free action when you hit to add 2d6 fire or necrotic (devil's choice when bound).

features.name: Corrupt Spell
features.description: When you cast a Reaver spell of 1st rank+, you may deal +1d6 necrotic to one target and become lightly corrupted until a short rest (Guide tracks corruption; at 3 stacks disadvantage on Judgment social rolls until long rest).

features.name: Blight Bolt
features.description: Cantrip: ranged spell attack 60 feet, 1d10 necrotic; scales Cantrip d10. On hit, target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Decay Aura
features.description: Aura 10 feet: enemies starting turn there take 1d4 necrotic. Scales Ongoing d4 every 5 from 9.

features.name: Bulwark
features.description: While wielding a shield, +1 AC. Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Challenge
features.description: Bonus action: challenge a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has disadvantage on attacks against others while within 5 feet of you; you have advantage on attacks against it. Uses = Confidence modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Cleave
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, make one melee attack against a different creature within reach as part of the same attack (once per turn).

features.name: Coil
features.description: Bonus action: take a coiled stance until you move. Your next spear attack has advantage and deals +1d6; if it hits, you may move 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Countersong
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 60 feet fails a Judgment or Confidence roll against a charm/fear effect, add your Confidence modifier to the result. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Crescendo
features.description: Once per long rest when you cast a Songsmith spell of 1st rank+, treat it as one slot rank higher and Verse die becomes 1d10 for 1 minute.

features.name: Burning Chorus
features.description: When you deal damage with a Songsmith cantrip or spell, add +1d6 fire once per cast.

features.name: Anthem
features.description: Action: allies within 30 feet gain +2 to attacks and damage for 1 minute. Once per long rest.

features.name: Black Rose Elegy
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute Thorned Lullaby auto-succeeds once per turn (still costs bonus action), Wilting Note deals 4d6, and frightened enemies take 2d6 psychic at the start of their turns.

features.name: Borrowed Miracle
features.description: Once per short rest, cast a 1st- or 2nd-rank Wraith spell without expending a slot.

features.name: Burning Wings
features.description: Learn Seraphim Invocations. Bonus action: for 1 minute gain fly speed 30 feet (hover). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. While flying, Grace Bolt fire die becomes 1d6.

features.name: Charity
features.description: Action: transfer any number of your temporary HP to allies within 30 feet, or spend a short-rest slot to heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Intellect. Once per short rest for the slot heal.

features.name: Harvest
features.description: When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, as a bonus action move up to half your speed and make one melee weapon attack against a different creature.

features.name: Grim Momentum
features.description: After Harvest, your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn has advantage.

features.name: Grudge
features.description: Bonus action: mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute. Add 1d6 damage on weapon attacks against it. One mark; replacing ends the old. Scales Brand d6 every 5.

features.name: Fate's Favor
features.description: Once per long rest, after seeing a d20 within 60 feet but before outcome, replace the result with 10.

features.name: Double Hex
features.description: Maintain two hexes at once.

features.name: Grand Malediction
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, hex every enemy within 30 feet for 1 minute; hex die for this casting is 2d6.

features.name: Draw Breath
features.description: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your Warrior level. 1 use, recharges on a short or long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you may make 2 extra attacks (three times total).

features.name: Familiar
features.description: Bind a familiar (tiny; HP 10 + 2 x Witch level; AC 12 + Confidence modifier). It acts on your turn. Sense-share as a bonus action. At 0 HP it vanishes and returns after a long rest or a 1-hour ritual plus a 1st-rank slot.

features.name: Familiar's Bite
features.description: Familiar melee attack: 2d6 + Confidence modifier necrotic or psychic, reach 5 feet.

features.name: Grand Coven
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute allies within 30 feet add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of each spell they cast, and enemies in the aura have disadvantage on rolls against your spell DCs.

features.name: Grace
features.description: Bonus action: touch a creature to restore hit points equal to 1d8 + Judgment modifier. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Divine Arms
features.description: You are proficient with martial weapons and heavy armor. As a bonus action for 1 minute, your weapon counts as magical and deals +1d4 radiant. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Heavenly Strike
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-rank slot, +1d8 per slot rank above 1st, +1d8 if the target is undead or fiend.

features.name: Heavenly Presence
features.description: Aura 10 feet: allies add +1 to rolls against fear and charm. You shed dim light 10 feet.

scaling.change: Heavenly Presence(2): aura 30 feet; +1 to allies' AC
Heavenly Presence(3): aura 30 feet; allies in aura regain 1d4 HP at start of your turn

features.name: Greater Heavenly Strike
features.description: Heavenly Strike base becomes 3d8, and you may trigger it once per turn without expending a slot dealing 2d8 radiant (still scales with slots if you expend one).

features.name: Grand Order
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute your Heavenly Strike free trigger deals 4d8 radiant, and your aura grants allies advantage on Judgment and Endurance rolls.

features.name: Grave Hunger
features.description: While you have temporary HP from Witch features, spell attacks deal +1d8 necrotic.

features.name: Gravefire
features.description: Bonus action: your weapon sheds 1d6 necrotic for 1 minute; when you drop a creature to 0, one enemy within 10 feet takes 1d6 necrotic. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Fallen Strength
features.description: While you are below half HP, add your Judgment modifier to melee damage (min +1).

features.name: Grand Grimoire
features.description: Your spellbook can hold ritual versions of any Mage spell you know; rituals take 10 minutes and do not expend slots. You prepare two extra spells.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: Choose an element (fire, cold, lightning, or force). Your cantrips and Mage spells that deal that damage type add +1d4. Change attunement on a long rest.

features.name: Empowered Element
features.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for your attuned element, reroll any 1s on those dice.

features.name: Elemental Pierce
features.description: Attuned-element spells ignore resistance (not immunity).

features.name: Gatekeeper
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, open a gate for 1 minute to a known location on the same plane within 100 miles, or summon a single powerful allied spirit (Guide profile) for 1 minute that obeys your commands.

features.name: Dream Step
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 15 feet to a space you can see. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest. Does not provoke.

features.name: Dream Slot
features.description: After a long rest, choose one prepared Mage spell of 1st or 2nd rank; you may cast it once without a slot before your next long rest.

features.name: Dream Echo
features.description: Reaction: when you are hit, teleport up to 30 feet and the attacker makes an Intellect roll vs your Intellect DC or misses. Uses = Intellect modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Forced Command
features.description: Bonus action: choose one of your summons; it immediately takes one action (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Help, or a listed summon action). Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

scaling.change: Forced Command(2): the summon also moves up to its speed; 2 uses refresh on short rest as well as the long-rest pool once each short rest (max proficiency bonus still)

features.name: Empowered Summons
features.description: Your summons add your Intellect modifier (min +1) to damage rolls.

scaling.change: Empowered Summons(2): also +proficiency bonus to damage once per summon turn

features.name: Grave Bond
features.description: When an undead summon within 30 feet hits, you may use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic to the target or regain 1d6 HP. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Forge Titan
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, expend a 5th-rank summoning slot (or your highest) to call a Huge construct for 1 minute (Guide titan profile) that does not count against Legion cap.

features.name: Ghost Step
features.description: When you Hide, you may move 10 feet without revealing yourself. Shadowstep distance for teleport (when gained) increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Grand Deceiver
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you have advantage on Confidence and Precision rolls, Misdirection does not expend uses, and Arcane Ambush applies even when not hidden.

features.name: Elemental Palm
features.description: Action: 15-ft cone of your element, 4d6 damage (Speed vs Precision DC halves). Once per short rest.

features.name: Eclipse Touch
features.description: Melee spell attack or touch: 2d8 radiant (Light) or necrotic (Shade); Judgment roll vs Judgment DC or blinded until end of its next turn. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Dusk Mantle
features.description: Reaction: when you or an ally within 30 feet is hit, grant resistance to that damage. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Herald of Twilight
features.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute you embody both Veils: healing and spell damage bonuses both apply at +2d6, and Litany applies both the ally attack bonus and enemy attack penalty.

features.name: Halo Ward
features.description: Reaction: when an ally within 30 feet fails an Endurance or Judgment roll, add 1d8 to the result. Uses = Judgment modifier (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Exile
