legacy_races.traits: Elves of Sable, the primordial dragon of death. Black-skinned with bright purple-to-indigo eyes and a faint spectral shimmer, they walk calmly at the edge between life and its ending.

legacy_races.name: Hollowkin
legacy_races.traits: Survivors of Hollow exposure. Gaunt, with pale gray eyes and patches of their bodies gone hollow, they carry something empty inside them that the living find unsettling.

legacy_races.name: Rootborn
legacy_races.traits: Folk grown from the roots of the Tree of Life. Bark-skinned, with leaves for hair, they are slow, patient, and hard to move.

legacy_races.name: Cindral
legacy_races.traits: Ember-skinned people of Caldera's volcanic south, with cracks of molten light in their skin. They are cousins of the wyrmkin, not dragon-blooded themselves.

legacy_races.name: Vellari
legacy_races.traits: Fox folk of the Wildlands with two to five tails, quick, curious, and natural trackers. Each Vellari is born into one of eight gem lines, which sets their fur color: Opal (white, the classic look), Onyx (black), Amethyst (purple), Topaz (orange), Quartz (clear crystal), Emerald (green), Ruby (red), or Sapphire (blue).

legacy_races.name: Saltborn
legacy_races.traits: Blue-gray coastal people of Atheria's shores, with webbed hands and gill marks. They are sailors and traders by trade.

legacy_races.name: Wyrdling
legacy_races.traits: Small, moth-winged fae folk with glowing eyes. They drift around ruins and old magic.

legacy_races.name: Lumenwing
legacy_races.traits: Slender butterfly fae with large, brilliant wings whose patterns are unique to each one, like a fingerprint. Unlike the moth-winged Wyrdlings of the ruins, Lumenwings are sunlit folk of flowering groves: dazzling, flighty, and drawn to color and life.

legacy_races.name: Graniar
legacy_races.traits: Tall, slow mountain folk who look carved from living granite. They live for centuries and forget nothing.

legacy_races.name: Corvani
legacy_races.traits: Raven-feathered humanoids who carry messages, trade in secrets, and are said to keep watch over the dead.

legacy_races.name: Quillary
legacy_races.traits: Hedgehog-like small folk with spines down their backs. They are stubborn burrowers who are very hard to grab.

legacy_races.name: Lupine
legacy_races.traits: Loyal dog folk who live in packs, with looks that follow their breed lines. A Lupine might be a sturdy mastiff, a lean greyhound, a fluffy husky, a powerful rottweiler, a shepherd, or a hound.

legacy_races.name: Radiant
legacy_races.traits: Folk born with starlight in their blood. Seams of living gold light run beneath their skin like veins of ore, and the light flares brighter with emotion. Eldridian lore says the first Radiants were born where falling stars struck the earth. They have no wings; their gift is inner light. They are warm, steady protectors who see it as their duty to stand where the dark is deepest.

legacy_races.name: Skyborn
legacy_races.traits: Pale-blue folk with storm-white hair that is never still, even when the air is calm. They are said to be children of the high winds above Eldridia's clouds, carried down to the world on the first storm. Skyborn are wingless; the wind itself lifts them. Cheerful, restless wanderers and rescuers, they believe no one should ever be left behind.

legacy_races.name: Gehennan
legacy_races.traits: People born with devil blood, each bloodline believed to descend from a devil house of Gehenna. Glowing grooves mark their skin, and their irises share the color of the dark magic in their veins: red, purple, gold, or orange. They do not age and die only if struck down. Atheria's paladins persecute them on sight.

legacy_races.name: Orc
legacy_races.traits: Orcs came to Lys under King Barathos, when the kindest of the Alterian kings opened the realm's borders. They came as workers, soldiers, and settlers, and many earned their place the hard way, through the Second Great War and the long Civil Wars that followed. Strong, broad, and hard to kill, orcs are known in Lys for loyalty to whoever treats them fairly, and long memories for whoever doesn't. Where they came from before Lys is a story each clan tells differently.

legacy_races.name: Homunculi
legacy_races.traits: Artificial souls created by alchemists seeking immortality. Most are considered failed experiments and treated poorly, but some are treated as family. Their skin is ivory and porcelain-like, ringed with fine gold seams at the wrists, elbows and shoulders, and their soul is a sentient glossy black liquid that drifts around them in ribbons and droplets. They are rare, and most can blend into normal society. Languages: Trade plus one language of the player's choice.

legacy_subraces.name: Opal
legacy_subraces.description: Pearly white fur, the classic Vellari look. Resistance to radiant damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Onyx
legacy_subraces.description: Black fur. Resistance to necrotic damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Amethyst
legacy_subraces.description: Purple fur. Resistance to psychic damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Topaz
legacy_subraces.description: Orange fur. Resistance to lightning damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Quartz
legacy_subraces.description: Clear crystal fur. Resistance to force damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Emerald
legacy_subraces.description: Green fur. Resistance to poison damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Ruby
legacy_subraces.description: Red fur. Resistance to fire damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Sapphire
legacy_subraces.description: Blue fur. Resistance to cold damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Mastiff
legacy_subraces.description: A sturdy, heavy-set breed. +1 HP per level.

legacy_subraces.name: Greyhound
legacy_subraces.description: A lean, fast breed. +10 ft speed.

legacy_subraces.name: Husky
legacy_subraces.description: A fluffy breed from the cold. Resistance to cold damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Rottweiler
legacy_subraces.description: A powerful breed. Bite: 1d6 + Might as a bonus action, 1 per short rest.

legacy_subraces.name: Bloodhound
legacy_subraces.description: A keen-nosed hound. Track by scent across a trail up to a day old.

legacy_subraces.name: Moss Agate
legacy_subraces.description: Frosted white crystal fur veined with dark-green moss agate. Resistance to acid damage.

legacy_subraces.name: Wrathveined
legacy_subraces.description: Red veins, Red Magic (Offense). Resistance to fire damage. Veinfire deals fire; the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn.

legacy_subraces.name: Dusk-veined
legacy_subraces.description: Purple veins, Purple Magic (Weaken). Resistance to psychic damage. Veinfire deals psychic; the target has disadvantage on its next save against you.

legacy_subraces.name: Oathveined
legacy_subraces.description: Gold veins, Yellow Magic (Strengthen). Resistance to force damage. Veinfire deals force; you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

legacy_subraces.name: Rustveined
legacy_subraces.description: Orange veins, Orange Magic (Hinder). Resistance to acid damage. Veinfire deals acid; the target's speed drops by 10 ft.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Vanguard
legacy_sub_classes.description: You stand at the front of every fight, holding the line so your allies don't have to. Enemies who try to slip past you find themselves locked in place.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Weaponmaster
legacy_sub_classes.description: You have mastered every weapon you have ever picked up, and you carry one you trust like a part of yourself. Your technique turns a simple swing into an art.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Warlord
legacy_sub_classes.description: You lead from the front, calling the shots and pointing your allies at the gaps. One shout from you can rally a broken line and turn a losing fight around.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Evoker
legacy_sub_classes.description: You study raw elemental magic and shape it into fire, lightning, and frost. Your spells hit harder than most, and you can bend the blast around your friends.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Rune Weaver
legacy_sub_classes.description: You have studied the art of magic but still prefer a more physical combat approach. You weave runes into your armor and weapons to give you an edge over non-magic combatants.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Scholar
legacy_sub_classes.description: You treat magic as a library to be mastered, collecting every secret you can find. You read omens, steal spells from your rivals, and forget nothing.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Hex Magic
legacy_sub_classes.description: You curse your enemies and make those curses linger. Your hexes spread from one victim to the next, until the very ground beneath them turns against them.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Blood Magic
legacy_sub_classes.description: You pay for power with your own blood, and you are always willing to pay. Your hexes drain life from your foes to heal the wounds your magic carves into you.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Fate Magic
legacy_sub_classes.description: You see the threads of fate and know which ones to pull. You twist luck in your favor, curse your enemies with doom, and slip out of fates meant for you.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Green Magic
legacy_sub_classes.description: You draw your magic from the wild green, letting things bloom or rot at your word. Vines snare your foes and the forest canopy hides you from sight.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Witch Knight
legacy_sub_classes.description: Where other witches whisper curses from the shadows, you carve them into your foes with steel. Your armor is black with hexes, and anything you've marked learns too late that it cannot escape you.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Oath of Ochre
legacy_sub_classes.description: You swore your oath to living things, the root and the leaf and the green that endures. Vines bind your foes and your strikes carry the strength of growing life.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Oath of Umber
legacy_sub_classes.description: You swore your oath to the dead and to the memory of those who passed on. You guide lost souls home and strike down those who cheat their way out of the grave.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Oath of Shadows
legacy_sub_classes.description: You swore your oath in the dark, bringing judgment where light cannot reach. You slip through shadows and strike before your enemies know they are hunted.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Oath of Starlight
legacy_sub_classes.description: You swore your oath to the distant stars and the cold void between them. You mark your foes with starlight and cut them down with blades edged in the dark beyond.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Shadowblade
legacy_sub_classes.description: You strike from the dark and are gone before the body hits the floor. Shadows bend to carry you, and in time they learn to fight beside you.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Venombound
legacy_sub_classes.description: You trust poison more than steel, mixing toxins that sap strength and cloud the mind. Your own blood has turned bitter from years of handling them.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Ghostwalker
legacy_sub_classes.description: You can become anyone, slipping into a stolen face and leaving no trace behind. When the job is done, even the people who saw you forget you were there.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Cavalier
legacy_sub_classes.description: You were raised in the saddle, and you and your mount fight as one. Your charges break lines and knock riders to the dirt.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Shieldbearer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You plant your shield and become the wall your allies hide behind. Charges break against you, and no one gets past while you stand.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Crownguard
legacy_sub_classes.description: You have sworn your life to protect someone greater than yourself. You challenge any who threaten your charge and will step in front of the blade meant for them.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Archer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You live and die by the bow, whether up close or from across the field. Your aim is patient and your arrows fall like rain on anyone who stands against you.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Tamer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You never hunt alone, with a loyal beast always at your side. The two of you move as one, sharing every target and guarding each other's backs.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Stalker
legacy_sub_classes.description: You blend steel and spellwork, fighting with a blade in each hand. You dart in and out of the fight, marking your prey with hexes your blades follow home.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Circle of the Root
legacy_sub_classes.description: You draw strength from deep roots, wrapping yourself in bark and holding enemies fast with the grasping earth. Trees open paths for you, and forests rise where you call them.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Circle of the Beast
legacy_sub_classes.description: You would rather fight with fang and claw than with spells. You take the shapes of beasts and elements alike, becoming the most dangerous predator in any fight.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Circle of the Season
legacy_sub_classes.description: You carry the turning year inside you, calling down storms, frost, or summer heat at will. Your power shifts with the seasons, and the weather answers your mood.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Frenzied
legacy_sub_classes.description: You fight in a howling blur, swinging faster the angrier you get. Every blow that lands on you only feeds the next wave of steel.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Ironhide
legacy_sub_classes.description: You don't dodge hits, you take them and keep walking. Your rage hardens your body until you stand like a mountain no one can move.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Bloodwake
legacy_sub_classes.description: You smell blood and it drives you forward. Every wound you open makes you stronger, and the fight only ends when the field runs red.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Way of the Tiger
legacy_sub_classes.description: You fight like a hunting cat, rushing in with sudden pounces and raking blows. You watch for weakness and strike the moment your prey falters.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Way of the Bear
legacy_sub_classes.description: You fight like a bear, grabbing hold and crushing the fight out of your foes. Your hide is thick, and once you have someone in your grip they are not getting out.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Way of Iron
legacy_sub_classes.description: You have trained your body until it is as hard as iron. Your fists break guards, crack armor, and send shockwaves through anything you hit.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Phalanx
legacy_sub_classes.description: You fight shoulder to shoulder with your allies, spears leveled in an unbroken line. Together you hold ground that no single warrior could.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Skyreach
legacy_sub_classes.description: You leap high over the battlefield and drop on your enemies from above. Your foes learn to fear the sky, because that is where your spear comes from.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Twinstrike
legacy_sub_classes.description: You wield a spear in each hand, striking and guarding in the same motion. Your paired points fill the air with steel, leaving foes nowhere safe to stand.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Lightbearer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You carry the light of the dawn and pour it out on the battlefield. Your radiance shields your allies and burns away anything that hides from the sun.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Binder
legacy_sub_classes.description: You are a warden against things that should not walk the world. You seal away evil spirits and hollow horrors with sacred circles and holy sigils.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Whisper
legacy_sub_classes.description: You serve a quieter faith, one of secrets spoken in the dark. Shadows carry your whispers, and every confession you hear becomes a debt you can collect.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Necromancer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You raise the dead to fight for you, from a single bone servant to a marching army. Death is not the end of your soldiers, only the start of their service.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Hollowmancer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You have dared to tame the hollow rot that devours magic and life. Your hungry pack spreads decay through your enemies and eats away at their spells.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Technomancer
legacy_sub_classes.description: You build your summons from scrap, gears, and stolen power. Your drones swarm the field and your iron machines march where flesh would fall.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Warsong
legacy_sub_classes.description: You sing on the front line, and your songs turn fear into fury. Your battle hymns keep your allies marching when everything else says run.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Loresong
legacy_sub_classes.description: You collect stories, languages, and secrets the way others collect coins. Your words cut as deep as any blade, and there is little you cannot learn to do.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Diresong
legacy_sub_classes.description: You sing the songs of mourning, and your notes toll like a funeral bell. Your music shelters the living and calls the end for those whose time has come.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Rite of the Archon
legacy_sub_classes.description: You bound an Archon, a warden of celestial law. Its chains answer your verdicts, pinning the guilty in place until sentence is passed.
legacy_sub_classes.breach_effect: One creature of the GM's choice within 30 ft (ally or enemy) is restrained until the end of its next turn (save ends, class DC).

legacy_sub_classes.name: Rite of the Seraph
legacy_sub_classes.description: You bound a Seraph, a six-winged burning choir. Its fire pours out of every crack in your seal and lifts you into the sky.
legacy_sub_classes.breach_effect: 10-ft burst centered on you: 3d8 radiant to every creature but you (Precision roll, class DC, half).

legacy_sub_classes.name: Rite of the Virtue
legacy_sub_classes.description: You bound a Virtue, a celestial of mercy. You spend its stolen grace to mend allies, turn aside doom, and drag the newly dead back to life.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Mark of Crossroads
legacy_sub_classes.description: Debuffs and trades. Your devil keeps a ledger: creatures that hurt you become Indebted, and you collect with interest.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Mark of Legion
legacy_sub_classes.description: Frontline tank. Your devil is a soldier of the infernal ranks; you hold the line and drill your allies to fight as one.

legacy_sub_classes.name: Mark of Possession
legacy_sub_classes.description: Possession, misdirection, control. Your devil whispers charms and terrors through you. Third caster (Confidence) from level 3.
legacy_sub_classes.spellcasting: Full caster from Reaver level 3, using Confidence; slots copied from the Songsmith (Shared Frame full-caster table). Possession spell list; soul brand is the focus.

personality_options.name: Orphan
personality_options.flavor: Raised by a temple that took in foundlings.
personality_options.perk: Once per long rest, you can calm one frightened creature you can touch (it ends the frightened condition).
personality_options.bio: You grew up in a temple that took in foundlings.

personality_options.name: Nobility
personality_options.flavor: Raised in a noble house, giving orders from childhood.
personality_options.perk: Once per long rest, you can call on your family name to gain lodging, an audience or a small favour.
personality_options.bio: You grew up comfortably among castle walls, giving orders from childhood.

personality_options.name: Nomad
personality_options.flavor: Raised on the move, never staying anywhere long.
personality_options.perk: You never get lost while travelling overland, and you need half the usual rest to recover from a forced march.
personality_options.bio: You grew up on the move, never staying anywhere long.

personality_options.name: Theater Troupe
personality_options.flavor: Raised on the road with players and tricksters.
personality_options.perk: You gain proficiency in Showmanship, and you can change your look with stage paint during a short rest.
personality_options.bio: You grew up on the road with players and tricksters.

personality_options.name: Merchant Caravan
personality_options.flavor: Raised haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.
personality_options.perk: You always know the fair price of common goods, and you buy and sell them 10% better.
personality_options.bio: You grew up haggling at the wagons of a trading caravan.

personality_options.name: River-Barge Family
personality_options.flavor: Raised working the barges with your kin.
personality_options.perk: You gain a swim speed equal to half your speed, and you never suffer motion sickness.
personality_options.bio: You grew up working the river barges with your kin.

personality_options.name: Archive Scribes
personality_options.flavor: Raised copying and guarding texts in an archive.
personality_options.perk: You learn two extra languages.
personality_options.bio: You grew up copying and guarding the texts of an archive.

personality_options.name: Frontier Hunters
personality_options.flavor: Raised in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.
personality_options.perk: You have advantage on checks to track beasts.
personality_options.bio: You grew up in a hunting camp on the edge of settled land.

personality_options.name: City Guild Apprentice
personality_options.flavor: Apprenticed young to a crafting guild.
personality_options.perk: You gain proficiency with one artisan's tool of your choice.
personality_options.bio: You grew up as a young apprentice in a city crafting guild.

personality_options.name: Plague-Ward Healers
personality_options.flavor: Raised among the healers of a sickhouse.
personality_options.perk: You have advantage on saves against disease, and you can identify any poison by smell.
personality_options.bio: You grew up among the healers of a sickhouse.

personality_options.name: Border Garrison
personality_options.flavor: Raised inside a fort on a contested border.
personality_options.perk: While you keep watch during a rest, you and your allies can't be surprised.
personality_options.bio: You grew up inside a fort on a contested border.

personality_options.name: Hermit's Ward
personality_options.flavor: Taught alone by a reclusive caster.
personality_options.perk: Once per long rest, you can ask the GM one yes-or-no question about a place you can see.
personality_options.bio: You grew up alone, taught by a reclusive caster.

personality_options.name: Lighthouse Keepers
personality_options.flavor: Raised tending a storm-coast lighthouse.
personality_options.perk: You can see through rain, fog and snow as if they weren't there, out to 60 ft.
personality_options.bio: You grew up tending a lighthouse on a stormy coast.

personality_options.name: Highland Shepherds
personality_options.flavor: Raised driving flocks through high pastures.
personality_options.perk: Nonmagical cold never harms you, and beasts of the herd follow your calls.
personality_options.bio: You grew up driving flocks through the high pastures.

personality_options.name: Fighting Pits
personality_options.flavor: Raised fighting in the pits for coin and food.
personality_options.perk: Once per long rest, when you spend Hit Dice, regain 1 extra Hit Die worth of HP.
personality_options.bio: You grew up fighting in the pits for coin and food.

personality_options.name: Marsh Fosterage
personality_options.flavor: Fostered by marsh folk who brewed with what grew there.
personality_options.perk: You can brew one basic poison or antidote dose during each long rest, using marsh plants.
personality_options.bio: You grew up fostered by marsh folk who brewed with what grew there.

personality_options.name: Gravedigger's Yard
personality_options.flavor: Raised among the gravediggers of a burial ground.
personality_options.perk: As an action, you can sense undead within 30 ft (1 per short rest).
personality_options.bio: You grew up among the gravediggers of a burial ground.

personality_options.name: Self-Taught Stray
personality_options.flavor: Raised by no one, so you taught yourself.
personality_options.perk: Gain +1 spell known. It still counts against your highest spell level.
personality_options.bio: You grew up with no one to raise you, so you taught yourself.

personality_options.name: Smugglers' Den
personality_options.flavor: Raised among smugglers who ran goods at night.
personality_options.perk: You have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
personality_options.bio: You grew up among smugglers who ran goods by night.

personality_options.name: Solitary
personality_options.flavor: Lives apart and reshapes themselves alone.
personality_options.perk: Alone you learned to remake yourself: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days apart from others, reshaping yourself alone.

personality_options.name: Protector
personality_options.flavor: Stands between others and harm.
personality_options.perk: Guarding others comes naturally: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days standing between others and harm.

personality_options.name: Hero
personality_options.flavor: Seeks out danger to lift others up.
personality_options.perk: Lifting others up is second nature: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days seeking out danger to lift others up.

personality_options.name: Delinquent
personality_options.flavor: Breaks every rule put in front of them.
personality_options.perk: No rule holds you for long: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days breaking every rule put in front of you.

personality_options.name: Criminal
personality_options.flavor: Works angles, deals and fixes for a living.
personality_options.perk: Every deal is a lever: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days working angles, deals and fixes for a living.

personality_options.name: Brawler
personality_options.flavor: Settles things head-on and hard.
personality_options.perk: You hit first and hardest: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days settling things head-on and hard.

personality_options.name: Con Artist
personality_options.flavor: Lives behind a string of false faces.
personality_options.perk: A false face fits you well: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days behind a string of false faces.

personality_options.name: Wanderer
personality_options.flavor: Lives off whatever the road provides.
personality_options.perk: The road always provides: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days wandering from town to town, living off the road.

personality_options.name: Artisan
personality_options.flavor: Lives to build and make things.
personality_options.perk: Your hands know how to make: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days building and making things.

personality_options.name: Grudge-Keeper
personality_options.flavor: Lives to pay back every wrong.
personality_options.perk: You never forget a wrong: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days paying back every wrong done to you.

personality_options.name: Caretaker
personality_options.flavor: Lives looking after the sick and the weak.
personality_options.perk: Mending others is your craft: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days looking after the sick and the weak.

personality_options.name: Beastkeeper
personality_options.flavor: Lives with animals and calls them kin.
personality_options.perk: Your kin answer when called: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days among animals you call kin.

personality_options.name: Commander
personality_options.flavor: Lives to lead and be obeyed.
personality_options.perk: Others are used to obeying you: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days leading others and being obeyed.

personality_options.name: Enforcer
personality_options.flavor: Keeps others in line by holding them down.
personality_options.perk: You know how to hold someone down: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days keeping others in line by holding them down.

personality_options.name: Free Spirit
personality_options.flavor: Lives unbound by ties or promises.
personality_options.perk: Nothing keeps you tied: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days unbound by ties or promises.

personality_options.name: Ravager
personality_options.flavor: Lives by tearing down whatever stands.
personality_options.perk: Ruin follows in your wake: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: You spend your days tearing down whatever still stands.

personality_options.name: Confident
personality_options.flavor: Sure of their own strength.
personality_options.perk: Certainty fuels your force: your Evoke spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your confident outlook leaves you sure of your own strength.

personality_options.name: Defiant
personality_options.flavor: Refuses any limit set on them.
personality_options.perk: Limits exist to be broken: your Break spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your defiant outlook refuses any limit set on you.

personality_options.name: Hopeful
personality_options.flavor: Believes things will turn out well.
personality_options.perk: Your faith in good outcomes shows: your Bless spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your hopeful outlook tells you things will turn out well.

personality_options.name: Secretive
personality_options.flavor: Shows no one who they really are.
personality_options.perk: Hiding is habit: your Illusion spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your secretive outlook shows no one who you really are.

personality_options.name: Curious
personality_options.flavor: Always wants to see what comes next.
personality_options.perk: Your wonder calls things forth: your Conjure spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your curious outlook always wants to see what comes next.

personality_options.name: Calculated
personality_options.flavor: Weighs every move before making it.
personality_options.perk: Every move is planned: your Manipulate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your calculated outlook weighs every move before you make it.

personality_options.name: Visionary
personality_options.flavor: Sees what could be built.
personality_options.perk: You see what could be: your Create spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your visionary outlook sees what could be built.

personality_options.name: Cautious
personality_options.flavor: Guards against every risk.
personality_options.perk: You shut every door behind you: your Seal spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your cautious outlook guards against every risk.

personality_options.name: Bitter
personality_options.flavor: Feels the world owes them.
personality_options.perk: Your resentment takes shape: your Curse spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your bitter outlook says the world owes you.

personality_options.name: Modest
personality_options.flavor: Thinks little of themselves, much of others.
personality_options.perk: You give more than you take: your Restore spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your modest outlook on life leaves you happy with what you have.

personality_options.name: Devoted
personality_options.flavor: Defines themselves by who they serve or stand with.
personality_options.perk: Those you serve answer you: your Summon spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your devoted outlook defines you by who you serve and stand with.

personality_options.name: Proud
personality_options.flavor: Sees themselves above others.
personality_options.perk: You expect others to bow: your Subjugate spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your proud outlook sets you above others.

personality_options.name: Self-Loathing
personality_options.flavor: Wishes they were someone else.
personality_options.perk: You long to be someone else: your Transmute spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your self-loathing outlook wishes you were someone else.

personality_options.name: Greedy
personality_options.flavor: Wants to hold on to everything.
personality_options.perk: What you grab, you keep: your Bind spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your greedy outlook wants to hold on to everything.

personality_options.name: Carefree
personality_options.flavor: Lets nothing weigh on them.
personality_options.perk: You let everything go: your Release spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your carefree outlook lets nothing weigh on you.

personality_options.name: Nihilistic
personality_options.flavor: Sees nothing worth keeping.
personality_options.perk: Nothing is worth keeping: your Destroy spells are cast one band stronger (max Attuned).
personality_options.bio: Your nihilistic outlook sees nothing worth keeping.

primordial_blessings.name: Many Faces
primordial_blessings.description: Action: change your appearance (not size) for 1 hour; Knowledge (blessing DC) to see through it.

primordial_blessings.name: Trickster's Feint

primordial_blessings.name: Hearthblood
primordial_blessings.description: Max HP +2 per level (retroactive). When you spend Hit Dice, add your Endurance modifier once more per die.

primordial_blessings.name: Second Breath
primordial_blessings.description: +1 Endurance. Once per short rest, when you start your turn below half HP, regain 2d6 + Endurance modifier HP (no action).

primordial_blessings.name: Ever-Watchful
primordial_blessings.description: +Proficiency Bonus to initiative; you can't be surprised while conscious.

primordial_blessings.name: Keen Wits
primordial_blessings.description: +1 Intellect, Judgment or Confidence; proficiency in one skill and one tool.

primordial_blessings.name: Silver Tongue
primordial_blessings.description: Proficiency in Diplomacy or Misdirection (expertise if already proficient). Once per long rest, reroll a failed Confidence check.

role_features.description: Temper pool: ceil(Reaver level / 2) + Confidence modifier (minimum 1); from level 17 add Endurance. All back on a long rest, half your max (rounded down) on a short rest. Once per turn, when you drop a creature to 0 HP or take a critical hit, regain 1 Temper. Stability: Strain 0-5. Spending 3+ Temper in one turn or using a (Strain) feature adds 1 Strain (max 2 per turn; a Strain feature costing 3+ adds only 1). Heat: +1 force damage per Strain on soul brand and hammer hits. Fray (3+ Strain): disadvantage on Confidence rolls and concentration checks (until level 20). Overflow: at 5 Strain, further Strain becomes 1 Crossing. Cooling: short rest removes 2 Strain; long rest removes all Strain and Crossing. Crossing (0-3): at 3 your devil crosses over for 1 minute (2 from 17) as an ally acting on your turn with HP = 5 x your level. When it drops or its time ends while you have 3+ Strain, make a DC 15 Confidence roll (12 from 13); on a fail it stays 1 more round acting on its own (your Mark's Crossing effect). Crossing then resets to 0.

role_features.description: The soul brand is a mark, not a weapon. You place it on one weapon you own (tick Soul Brand on the weapon): touch it for 1 minute (can be done during a short or long rest). Branding a new weapon ends the old brand at once. The branded weapon uses its own category and stats; you can use Confidence instead of Might or Precision for its attack and damage rolls, and it can't be disarmed from you while you're conscious. The brand can't go on a weapon larger than your size. Features that name the soul brand mean your branded weapon. Oversized weapons: you're proficient with weapons of any size. role_features.description: The sigil blade is no longer a weapon: it is a sigil mark you place on one weapon you own (tick Sigil mark on the weapon), one at a time. Marking takes 10 minutes of tracing the sigil (can be done during a short or long rest); placing a new mark ends the old one at once. You can use Intellect instead of Might or Precision for attack and damage rolls with the marked weapon. The marked weapon counts as a "sigil blade" for every feature (Sigil Strike, the Crack radiant bonus, Grace Leech). It is not a focus. The mark can go on any weapon you're proficient with (Minor, Elegant One-Handed, Broad One-Handed).
role_features.name: Sigil Mark

role_features.description: You have Embers of Grace equal to ceil(Wraith level / 2) + Intellect modifier (minimum 1); from level 17 add your Endurance modifier. Regain all on a long rest and half your maximum (rounded down) on a short rest. You also track Seal Cracks (0 to 5): each Crack adds +1 radiant damage to sigil-marked weapon, chain whip, and flail hits. At 3+ Cracks you shed bright light 10 ft (dim 10 ft more), can't Hide, and take radiant damage equal to your Cracks at the start of each turn (ignores resistance). Spending 3+ embers in one turn adds 1 Crack (a Crack feature costing 3+ adds only 1 total); max 2 Cracks per turn except Stolen Resurrection. Breach: if you would gain a 6th Crack, make a DC 15 Endurance roll (Cracks stay at 5). Fail: stunned until the end of your next turn and your bound entity's Breach effect happens (Archon: a creature of the GM's choice within 30 ft is restrained until the end of its next turn, save ends; Seraph: 10-ft burst, 3d8 radiant to all but you, Precision roll half; Virtue: you lose all remaining embers). Mending: a short rest removes 2 Cracks, a long rest removes all, and Cracks drop by 1 after 10 minutes without gaining any.
role_features.name: Stolen Radiance

role_features.description: Bonus action: if your marked weapon is within 60 ft and not held by another creature, it dissolves into light and reforms in your hand; each creature within 5 ft of where it was takes radiant damage equal to your Crack count (0 at 0 Cracks). role_features.description: Wrested Wings lasts 1 minute. Add your Endurance modifier to your embers maximum.
role_features.name: Wings and Pool

role_features.description: Learn one Sigil Litany option you don't already have. When you gain a level, you can swap one Sigil Litany option for another.
role_features.name: Sigil Litany

role_features.description: Gain your subclass's level 18 feature.
role_features.name: Subclass feature

role_features.description: Your ability score cap becomes 22. No pick at this level.
role_features.name: Cap Rise

data.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Grace Bolt targets up to six creatures within 60 feet (no clustering required), Siphon Grace heals Intellect + proficiency bonus, and you regain one short-rest slot at the start of each of your turns (max your slot total).

role_features.name: Unchained
role_features.feature_description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, for 1 minute Grace Bolt targets up to six creatures within 60 feet (no clustering required), Siphon Grace heals Intellect + proficiency bonus, and you regain one short-rest slot at the start of each of your turns (max your slot total).

role_features.description: You earn the level 20 title Sacred Chains: Intellect and Endurance +2 (cap 24); resistance to radiant and necrotic damage; Cracks no longer deal leak damage (light and no-Hide still apply).
role_features.name: Sacred Chains

role_features.description: You make 4 attacks when you take the Attack action (martial parity).
role_features.name: Extra Attack (4)

role_features.description: 1 use per long rest: after you make a Breach save (pass or fail), bind the surge instead: no stun, no Breach effect, Cracks reset to 2. Up to Intellect modifier creatures within 30 ft make a Might roll (class DC) or are restrained by spectral chains (save ends).
role_features.name: Bind the Surge

role_features.description: Choose one: an Ability Boost (+2 to one ability score, or +1 to two) or one Primordial Blessing (Ochre's, Umber's or Sable's). No score can go above 22.
role_features.name: Ability Boost

role_features.description: Regain 4 extra embers on a short rest. The first Crack you gain each combat (after rolling initiative) doesn't make you shed light.
role_features.name: Unbroken Vessel

role_features.description: Your ability score cap becomes 24. No pick at this level.
role_features.name: Cap Rise

role_features.description: Sigil Strike deals +3d8 radiant. Reseal temporary HP becomes 3d6 + Endurance.
role_features.name: Sigil Strike 3d8

role_features.description: Choose one: an Ability Boost (+2 to one ability score, or +1 to two) or one Primordial Blessing (Ochre's, Umber's or Sable's). No score can go above 24.
role_features.name: Ability Boost

role_features.description: Gain your subclass's level 24 (mythic) feature.
role_features.name: Subclass feature

role_features.description: Immune to frightened and charmed. Celestial magic can't sense or scry you unless you allow it. Radiant Lash deals 8d8.
role_features.name: Grace Eternal

role_features.description: Shackle costs 1 ember and can target 2 creatures that move within your reach in the same round with one reaction.
role_features.name: Shackle Upgrade

role_features.description: Choose one: an Ability Boost (+2 to one ability score, or +1 to two) or one Primordial Blessing (Ochre's, Umber's or Sable's). No score can go above 24.
role_features.name: Ability Boost

role_features.description: Gain your subclass's level 28 (mythic) feature.
role_features.name: Subclass feature

role_features.description: +1 to one ability score (within the new cap of 26).
role_features.name: Primordial Ascent

role_features.description: Your ability score cap becomes 26. No pick at this level.
role_features.name: Cap Rise

role_features.description: You earn the level 30 title Divine Chains.
role_features.name: Divine Chains

role_features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: you're at 5 Cracks with no leak damage and no Breach saves (you can't gain Cracks); fly speed equal to twice your walking speed and you can hover; Sigil Strike costs 0 embers; your weapon and Wraith-feature damage is radiant and ignores resistance (immunity to radiant is treated as resistance). Once, you can drop to 1 HP instead of 0 (the class's one cheat-death). When it ends, gain 1 level of exhaustion and Cracks reset to 0.
role_features.name: Divine Chains Capstone

runes.name: Keen Rune
runes.effect: +1 to attack rolls with this weapon.

runes.name: Lantern Rune
runes.effect: Sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more; on or off as a bonus action.

runes.name: Anchor Rune
runes.effect: The item can't be disarmed or forcibly taken from its wielder while they're conscious.

runes.name: Homing Rune
runes.effect: A thrown weapon returns to the thrower's hand after the attack; ammunition fired is recovered after combat. (Thrown weapons or ranged weapons with ammunition.)

runes.name: Dusksight Rune
runes.effect: The wearer gains darkvision 30 ft (+30 ft if they already have it). (Worn gear.)

runes.name: Fleet Rune
runes.effect: +5 ft walking speed. (Armor or worn gear.)

runes.name: Warding Rune
runes.effect: Resistance to one damage type chosen when you inscribe it (not bludgeoning, piercing or slashing). (Armor, shield or worn gear.)

runes.name: Hush Rune
runes.effect: The item makes no noise; armor with it doesn't impose disadvantage on Stealth.

runes.name: Mending Rune
runes.effect: The item repairs itself in 1 minute; once per long rest, its wearer or wielder reduces one hit's damage by 1d6 + Intellect modifier (reaction).

species.name: Igni
species.description: Ember-skinned people of Caldera's volcanic south, with cracks of molten light in their skin. They are cousins of the wyrmkin, not dragon-blooded themselves.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Heatborn
traits.description: You ignore the effects of extreme heat.

traits.name: Flare
traits.description: Creatures within 5 ft of you make a Endurance roll or are blinded until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Ember Touch
traits.description: When you hit with a melee attack, deal an extra 1d6 fire damage.

traits.name: Molten Veins
traits.description: When a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage.

species.name: Human
species.description: You are ok sometimes

traits.name: Practiced
traits.description: +1 to one skill you are already proficient in.

traits.name: Jack of Trades
traits.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Second Wind of Will
traits.description: Reroll one failed ability check or save; must use the new roll.

species.name: Quillary
species.description: Hedgehog-like small folk with spines down their backs. They are stubborn burrowers who are very hard to grab.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Burrower
traits.description: 10 ft burrowing speed through loose earth and sand.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.description: Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Spines
traits.description: A creature that grapples you or hits you with an unarmed strike takes 1d4 piercing damage.

traits.name: Curl Up
traits.description: When you are attacked, gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn, but your speed becomes 0.

species.name: Dross
species.description: Blue-gray coastal people of Atheria's shores, with webbed hands and gill marks. They are sailors and traders by trade.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from cold damage.

traits.name: Trader's Tongue
traits.description: +2 to Diplomacy.

traits.name: Tidecall
traits.description: A 15 ft line of water pushes each creature in it 10 ft away from you. A Might roll negates the push.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water, and you have a 30 ft swim speed.

traits.name: Deckhand
traits.description: +2 to Presence.

species.name: Radiant
species.description: Folk born with starlight in their blood. Seams of living gold light run beneath their skin like veins of ore, and the light flares brighter with emotion. Eldridian lore says the first Radiants were born where falling stars struck the earth. They have no wings; their gift is inner light. They are warm, steady protectors who see it as their duty to stand where the dark is deepest.

traits.name: Radiant Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

traits.name: Starflare
traits.description: Your light bursts out. Each hostile creature within 10 ft makes a Endurance roll or is blinded until the end of your next turn, and you gain temporary HP equal to your level.

traits.name: Steady Glow
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

traits.name: Kindle
traits.description: When you hit a creature, deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage. The die becomes 2d6 at level 10.

traits.name: Inner Light
traits.description: Your veins shed dim light in a 10 ft radius. As a bonus action, you can make it bright light or dim it completely.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: You have an affinity for tools, and grew up at sea.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Quick Fix
traits.description: Repair a broken object or give a creature 1d6 temp HP by patching gear.

traits.name: Sea Legs
traits.description: +2 to Balance on ships or unstable footing; swim speed equal to walking speed.

traits.name: Toolwise
traits.description: Proficiency with two tools of your choice; add double proficiency with one.

species.name: Ouros
species.description: You have a draconic appearance, and the ability to breath fire

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Scaled Hide
traits.description: When not wearing armor, AC = 13 + Precision modifier.

traits.name: Draconic Presence
traits.description: +2 to Dominance.

traits.name: Fire Breath
traits.description: 15-ft cone, Precision roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Endurance), fire damage, half on success. Damage rises to 3d6 at 5, 4d6 at 11, 5d6 at 17.

species.name: Ent
species.description: Folk grown from the roots of the Tree of Life. Bark-skinned, with leaves for hair, they are slow, patient, and hard to move.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Sunmend
traits.description: While in sunlight, regain 1d8 + your level HP.

traits.name: Nature Kin
traits.description: +2 to Botany.

traits.name: Barkskin
traits.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + Precision modifier. You can still use a shield.

traits.name: Rooted
traits.description: Advantage on checks and saves against being shoved, moved against your will, or knocked prone.

species.name: Dawn Elf
species.description: You have bright green eyes, and attunement to nature.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Wildborn
traits.description: +2 to Botany.

traits.name: Rootbind
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Might roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Judgment) or is restrained by roots until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Green Sight
traits.description: Advantage on Botany checks to track and on Awareness checks in forests or wilds.

species.name: Vespar
species.description: Pale-blue folk with storm-white hair that is never still, even when the air is calm. They are said to be children of the high winds above Eldridia's clouds, carried down to the world on the first storm. Skyborn are wingless; the wind itself lifts them. Cheerful, restless wanderers and rescuers, they believe no one should ever be left behind.

traits.name: Lightning Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from lightning damage.

traits.name: Windborne Flight
traits.description: The wind lifts you, giving you a 30 ft flying speed for 1 minute. You must wear light or no armor. At level 10 this becomes permanent while you wear light or no armor.

traits.name: Gust
traits.description: Push a creature within 15 ft up to 10 ft away from you (Might roll negates), or move yourself 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Featherfall
traits.description: Fall no faster than 60 ft per round and take no falling damage.

traits.name: Windreader
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

species.name: Morvyne
species.description: Raven-feathered humanoids who carry messages, trade in secrets, and are said to keep watch over the dead.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Secret Keeper
traits.description: +2 to Knowledge.

traits.name: Gliding Wings
traits.description: Fall no faster than 60 ft per round, take no falling damage, and glide 2 ft horizontally for every 1 ft you fall.

traits.name: Deathwatch
traits.description: Sense whether a creature within 30 ft is dying, undead, or recently dead.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: +2 to Misdirection. You can perfectly mimic any voice or sound you have heard. A listener can see through it with an Awareness check against your Misdirection.

species.name: Gemine
species.description: Tall, slow mountain folk who look carved from living granite. They live for centuries and forget nothing.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Long Memory
traits.description: +2 to Memory.

traits.name: Stoneskin
traits.description: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Granite Body
traits.description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1d8 + your Endurance modifier.

traits.name: Unmoving
traits.description: Advantage on saves and checks against being shoved, knocked prone, or moved.

species.name: Vantus
species.description: Survivors of Hollow exposure. Gaunt, with pale gray eyes and patches of their bodies gone hollow, they carry something empty inside them that the living find unsettling.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Hollow Stare
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence) or is frightened until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Unfed
traits.description: You don't need to eat or drink for up to 7 days.

traits.name: Hollow Hunger
traits.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your level.

traits.name: Emptied Vessel
traits.description: Advantage on saves against disease and poison.

species.name: Lumen
species.description: Slender butterfly fae with large, brilliant wings whose patterns are unique to each one, like a fingerprint. Unlike the moth-winged Wyrdlings of the ruins, Lumenwings are sunlit folk of flowering groves: dazzling, flighty, and drawn to color and life.

traits.name: Radiant Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from radiant damage.

traits.name: Grace
traits.description: +2 to Showmanship.

traits.name: Butterfly Flight
traits.description: 30 ft flying speed while wearing light or no armor and not carrying a heavy load.

traits.name: Dazzling Wings
traits.description: One creature within 15 ft that can see you makes a Endurance roll or is blinded until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Bloomtouch
traits.description: Touch a creature to restore 1d6 + your level HP.

species.name: Uron
species.description: You have large claws, and a bear like appearance

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from fire damage.

traits.name: Mauling Roar
traits.description: Creatures of your choice within 15 ft make a Judgment roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Endurance) or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Hulking Grip
traits.description: +2 to Presence. Count as one size larger for carrying, pushing, and grapples.

traits.name: Bear Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons dealing 1d6 slashing; use Might.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs came to Lys under King Barathos, when the kindest of the Alterian kings opened the realm's borders. They came as workers, soldiers, and settlers, and many earned their place the hard way, through the Second Great War and the long Civil Wars that followed. Strong, broad, and hard to kill, orcs are known in Lys for loyalty to whoever treats them fairly, and long memories for whoever doesn't. Where they came from before Lys is a story each clan tells differently.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Thick-Boned
traits.description: You count as one size larger for carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting, and you have proficiency in Presence.

traits.name: Breaker's Charge
traits.description: Move up to your speed toward an enemy you can see; your next melee hit this turn deals +1d6.

traits.name: Bone-Shaker Roar
traits.description: Each creature of your choice within 15 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Endurance) or has disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Hard to Fell
traits.description: When you drop to 0 HP but aren't killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

species.name: Morrow Elf
species.description: You have bright red eyes, pale to dark skin, and have an affinity for mountainous terrain

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from cold damage.

traits.name: Stone Sense
traits.description: +2 to Awareness.

traits.name: Red Gaze
traits.description: One creature within 30 ft makes a Judgment roll (DC 8+Proficiency Bonus+Confidence) or has disadvantage on its next attack against you.

traits.name: Mountain-Born
traits.description: +2 to Presence when climbing; ignore difficult terrain from snow, ice, or rock.

species.name: Wyrdling
species.description: Small, moth-winged fae folk with glowing eyes. They drift around ruins and old magic.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Old Magic Sense
traits.description: Sense the presence and location of magic within 30 ft until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Moth Wings
traits.description: You have a 30 ft flying speed while wearing light armor or no armor. You can't fly while carrying more than half your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Dust Veil
traits.description: Become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

traits.name: Arcana Kin
traits.description: +2 to Arcana.

species.name: Gehennan
species.description: People born with devil blood, each bloodline believed to descend from a devil house of Gehenna. Glowing grooves mark their skin, and their irises share the color of the dark magic in their veins: red, purple, gold, or orange. They do not age and die only if struck down. Atheria's paladins persecute them on sight.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Vein Line
traits.description: Choose your vein color at character creation. It sets your eye and marking color, your resistance, and your Veinfire. Red: fire. Purple: psychic. Gold: force. Orange: acid.

traits.name: Kin-Sense
traits.description: +2 to Awareness. You also know whether a creature you can see within 30 ft is a devil or is bound to one.

traits.name: Devil's Endurance
traits.description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1d10 + your level.

traits.name: Ageless Blood
traits.description: You don't age and can't die of old age, and magic can't age you.

traits.name: Veinfire
traits.description: Your grooves and eyes flare. The next time you hit a creature before the end of your turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage of your Vein Line's type, plus its rider. The die becomes 2d6 at level 10. Red: the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn. Purple: the target has disadvantage on its next save against you before the end of your next turn. Gold: you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Orange: the target's speed drops by 10 ft until the end of its next turn.

species.name: Lupine
species.description: Loyal dog folk who live in packs, with looks that follow their breed lines. A Lupine might be a sturdy mastiff, a lean greyhound, a fluffy husky, a powerful rottweiler, a shepherd, or a hound.

traits.name: Pack Loyalty
traits.description: When a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 ft of you, impose disadvantage on that attack roll.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: +2 to Awareness. Advantage on smell-based checks.

traits.name: Howl
traits.description: Allies within 30 ft who can hear you gain 1d4 temporary HP and advantage on their next save against fear.

traits.name: Breed Line
traits.description: Choose a breed at character creation. Mastiff: +1 HP per level. Greyhound: +10 ft speed. Husky: cold resistance. Rottweiler: bite 1d6 + Might (bonus action, 1 per short rest). Shepherd: +2 Awareness. Hound: track by scent across up to a day-old trail.

species.name: Vellari
species.description: Fox folk of the Wildlands with two to five tails, quick, curious, and natural trackers. Each Vellari is born into one of eight gem lines, which sets their fur color: Opal (white, the classic look), Onyx (black), Amethyst (purple), Topaz (orange), Quartz (clear crystal), Emerald (green), Ruby (red), or Sapphire (blue).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: If you move at least 20 ft straight toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack on the same turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage.

traits.name: Gem Lineage
traits.description: Choose your gem line at character creation. It sets your fur color and gives resistance to one damage type: Opal radiant, Onyx necrotic, Amethyst psychic, Topaz lightning, Quartz force, Emerald poison, Ruby fire, Sapphire cold.

traits.name: Keen Nose
traits.description: +2 to Botany. Advantage on checks to track by scent.

traits.name: Quickfoot
traits.description: Take the Disengage action.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: You are known for being able to fit into small spaces, and have an affinity for slight of hand

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Nimble Fingers
traits.description: +2 to Finesse.

traits.name: Slip Away
traits.description: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

traits.name: Squeeze Through
traits.description: Move through spaces as small as 6 inches without slowing down; can move through larger creatures' spaces.

species.name: Dusk Elf
species.description: Elves of Sable, the primordial dragon of death. Black-skinned with bright purple-to-indigo eyes and a faint spectral shimmer, they walk calmly at the edge between life and its ending.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from necrotic damage.

traits.name: Veil of Sable
traits.description: When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, halve that damage.

traits.name: Deathsight
traits.description: You can see invisible spirits and undead within 30 ft.

traits.name: Grave Calm
traits.description: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

traits.name: Spectral Step
traits.description: Teleport up to 15 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

species.name: Homunculi
species.description: Artificial souls created by alchemists seeking immortality. Most are considered failed experiments and treated poorly, but some are treated as family. Their skin is ivory and porcelain-like, ringed with fine gold seams at the wrists, elbows and shoulders, and their soul is a sentient glossy black liquid that drifts around them in ribbons and droplets. They are rare, and most can blend into normal society. Languages: Trade plus one language of the player's choice.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.description: You take half damage from poison damage.

traits.name: Remold
traits.description: Minor remold (bonus action, at will): change your face and build within your current size: features, skin markings and colour, hair, eyes, voice pitch, height (up to 1 ft) and frame. Full remold (action, 1 per short rest; Proficiency Bonus per long rest from level 11): also change size between Small and Medium (speed 25/30 ft; a size change ends after 1 hour) or copy a specific Humanoid you saw clearly for 1 minute in the last 24 hours. Only your body changes, not your gear; armor fitted to your old size gives no AC until you change back. You can't change creature type, limbs, senses or statistics. A remold ends when you remold again, choose to, or drop to 0 HP. Advantage on Misdirection checks to pass as someone else while remolded. A suspicious creature can use its action for an Awareness check against DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Confidence to see through it.

traits.name: Soul Tide
traits.description: When a creature you can see within 5 ft hits you with an attack, your soul-liquid lashes out: reduce the damage by 1d6 + your Endurance modifier (minimum 1).

traits.name: Liquid Reach
traits.description: Your soul-liquid can carry out simple tasks within 5 ft: lift or hold an object of 5 lb or less, open an unlocked door or container, or pass an item to an adjacent ally. It can't attack, wield a weapon or activate magic items. Using it costs your free object interaction.

traits.name: Unfed Vessel
traits.description: You don't need to eat, drink or sleep. You go still for 4 hours to gain the benefit of a long rest, staying aware of your surroundings. Advantage on saves against being poisoned.

species.name: Dusk-veined
species.description: Purple veins, Purple Magic (Weaken). Resistance to psychic damage. Veinfire deals psychic; the target has disadvantage on its next save against you.

species.name: Oathveined
species.description: Gold veins, Yellow Magic (Strengthen). Resistance to force damage. Veinfire deals force; you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

species.name: Rustveined
species.description: Orange veins, Orange Magic (Hinder). Resistance to acid damage. Veinfire deals acid; the target's speed drops by 10 ft.

species.name: Wrathveined
species.description: Red veins, Red Magic (Offense). Resistance to fire damage. Veinfire deals fire; the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn.

species.name: Bloodhound
species.description: A keen-nosed hound. Track by scent across a trail up to a day old.

species.name: Greyhound
species.description: A lean, fast breed. +10 ft speed.

species.name: Husky
species.description: A fluffy breed from the cold. Resistance to cold damage.

species.name: Mastiff
species.description: A sturdy, heavy-set breed. +1 HP per level.

species.name: Rottweiler
species.description: A powerful breed. Bite: 1d6 + Might as a bonus action, 1 per short rest.

species.name: Shepherd
species.description: A watchful herding breed. +2 Awareness.

species.name: Amethyst
species.description: Purple fur. Resistance to psychic damage.

species.name: Emerald
species.description: Green fur. Resistance to poison damage.

species.name: Moss Agate
species.description: Frosted white crystal fur veined with dark-green moss agate. Resistance to acid damage.

species.name: Onyx
species.description: Black fur. Resistance to necrotic damage.

species.name: Opal
species.description: Pearly white fur, the classic Vellari look. Resistance to radiant damage.

species.name: Quartz
species.description: Clear crystal fur. Resistance to force damage.

species.name: Ruby
species.description: Red fur. Resistance to fire damage.

species.name: Sapphire
species.description: Blue fur. Resistance to cold damage.

species.name: Topaz
species.description: Orange fur. Resistance to lightning damage.

species_features.description: Minor remold (bonus action, at will): change your face and build within your current size: features, skin markings and colour, hair, eyes, voice pitch, height (up to 1 ft) and frame. Full remold (action, 1 per short rest; Proficiency Bonus per long rest from level 11): also change size between Small and Medium (speed 25/30 ft; a size change ends after 1 hour) or copy a specific Humanoid you saw clearly for 1 minute in the last 24 hours. Only your body changes, not your gear; armor fitted to your old size gives no AC until you change back. You can't change creature type, limbs, senses or statistics.
